jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customersto provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#Li-Hybrid

#### Job Description

We are seeking a curious and versatile Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with a strong track record of deploying, integrating, and troubleshooting complex virtualization and cloud environments. As part of our VDI Lab team, you will be responsible for building and evolving the environments that our product teams rely on — standing up new VDI platforms, thin client operating systems, and cloud desktop services, and researching how to integrate emerging technologies into our infrastructure.

Because the position is highly cross-functional, the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear and pragmatic way is essential. You will work side by side with product and engineering teams, and your work will become the foundation on which our endpoint capabilities are built and validated across virtualization and cloud desktop platforms.

**Responsibilities**

- Build and evolve the virtualization environments our endpoint products run on, across the major VDI and cloud desktop platforms.
- Automate it end to end: infrastructure as code, provisioning and image pipelines, so any engineer can get a working desktop on demand.
- Keep it running across public cloud and on-prem — networking, identity, and monitoring.
- Evaluate and integrate emerging endpoint technologies, from proof of concept to supported platform.
- Work with product managers, engineering teams, and technology partners to unlock and validate new platform coverage.
- Be the person other teams come to when they need to understand how a virtualization platform behaves.

#### Qualifications

**Must have**

- BSc/BEng or master's in computer science, or equivalent experience
- 5+ years of professional cloud infrastructure experience
- Deep hands-on experience with at least one major VDI/EUC platform — Citrix CVAD, Omnissa Horizon, Microsoft AVD / Windows 365, or Amazon WorkSpaces — and willingness to learn the others
- Strong Windows Server and hybrid identity foundations (Active Directory, Entra ID)
- A bias toward automation — Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, or whatever you've used to stop clicking through the same setup twice
- English proficiency.

**Where you've built depth** — we don't expect all of these; tell us which are yours

- Additional VDI platforms, brokers, or gateways (NetScaler/ADC, UAG)
- Hypervisor administration (vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix) and golden image lifecycle — build, optimization, patching, FSLogix
- Networking for virtual desktops — VLANs, firewalling, TLS, site-to-site VPN to AWS or Azure
- Cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS, and CI/CD or image pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Packer)
- Secure administration — RBAC, PIM, secrets management, vulnerability management
- Thin client and endpoint management — IGEL UMS, Dell Wyse Management Suite, Intune
- Synthetic testing / benchmarking — Login Enterprise (Login VSI) or similar

**How you work**

- You can explain a platform constraint to a product manager and a design trade-off to an engineer on the same day
- You're drawn to unfamiliar technology rather than wary of it — this role puts something new in front of you every quarter

#### Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

IIf you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! **Check what we offer:**

- Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
- 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
- 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR will be entirely covered by us.
- 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
- 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
- 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
- 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
- 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
- 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, soft drinks and protein shakes at the offie.
- 🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
- 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.
- 🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country.

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

_The base salary for this role is €42,000 – €70,000 gross per year, with a total on-target earnings (OTE) range of €46,000 – €77,000 including an annual performance bonus. You'll also be part of our broader total rewards package — including benefits tailored to where you live and how you work best._

_We set our pay ranges using objective criteria: the scope and level of the role, the skills it takes to do it well, and the relevant market data. Ranges are reviewed every year to remain competitive and fair. We're transparent about this because we think you deserve to know what you're working towards from day one. In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive (2023/970), we publish salary ranges on every Nexthink role. We won't ask what you currently earn or your previous salary. What matters to us is what this role is worth and whether it works for you. Nexthinkers come from all kinds of backgrounds, and that's what makes us stronger. We welcome applications from everyone._

jobs.description:
Nuestro cliente, compañía líder en España en el sector asegurador, necesita incorporar un Jefe de Proyecto con experiencia en **Informática MDM SaaS** para dar soporte al proyecto de migración de la versión on-premise a la versión SaaS. Se trata de un perfil senior, con conocimiento técnico de la herramienta, capaz de participar de forma autónoma en el proyecto y asegurar la calidad de la implantación.

Para reforzar el equipo del proyecto de implantación de Informática MDM SaaS, como solución de gestión de datos maestros, se necesita un perfil con experiencia contrastada en la plataforma que pueda incorporarse con autonomía, aportando criterio técnico y capacidad de seguimiento sin necesidad de supervisión continua.

La principal misión del puesto será acompañar al equipo durante las fases clave de la implantación, asegurando la calidad de la documentación técnica, validando los desarrollos realizados por el proveedor y colaborando en la preparación de la salida a producción.

El profesional trabajará de manera coordinada con las áreas de Tecnología, Arquitectura, Infraestructura y Operaciones, así como con el proveedor encargado de la implantación, garantizando el cumplimiento de los hitos del proyecto y facilitando la continuidad del servicio durante la ausencia temporal del responsable actual.

La duración inicial de la colaboración es de **3 meses (de octubre a diciembre) en formato interim**, aunque existe la posibilidad de una incorporación previa para poder realizar un adecuado traspaso de conocimiento.

Es una posición fija en Madrid, con **dedicación Full-time y en formato híbrido**(3 días presencial, 2 en remoto).

**En este contexto, sus funciones principales incluyen:**

• Validación de la documentación técnica del proyecto (diseño técnico, manuales de operación y documentación asociada), garantizando que cumple los estándares de calidad y el nivel de detalle requerido

• Realización y coordinación de pruebas funcionales para validar el correcto funcionamiento de la solución implantada

• Soporte durante la implantación en Producción, coordinándose con los equipos de Infraestructura y Operaciones (IO), Arquitectura y el resto de las áreas técnicas implicadas

• Seguimiento de la planificación y de los principales hitos del proyecto, identificando riesgos y asegurando el cumplimiento de los plazos establecidos

• Revisión técnica de los desarrollos realizados por el proveedor, verificando que se ajustan a las buenas prácticas y mantienen un nivel adecuado de calidad, sin necesidad de realizar una auditoría formal

• Colaboración con los distintos equipos implicados para asegurar una implantación estable y una correcta transición al modelo operativo

**Capacidades imprescindibles:**

• Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas de Información o similar

• Experiencia demostrable en proyectos de implantación de MDM SaaS y conocimiento técnico de la plataforma de Informática

• Experiencia en validación de documentación técnica y revisión de desarrollos

• Experiencia en ejecución de pruebas funcionales y soporte a despliegues en producción

• Capacidad de interlocución con equipos técnicos y proveedores

• Capacidad analítica, orientación a la calidad y seguimiento de proyectos

**Capacidades valorables:**

• Experiencia previa en proyectos similares dentro del sector asegurador o financiero

• Conocimiento de metodologías de gestión de proyectos

jobs.description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Systems Engineer to lead the design, deployment, and ongoing maintenance of our data center infrastructure. This position is critical to supporting our mission-critical systems and ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance across both on-premise and cloud environments.

The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in both Windows and Linux environments, extensive experience with monitoring and disaster recovery solutions, and a strong foundation in virtualization, cloud services, storage, and preferably high-performance computing (HPC). This role requires a hands-on, detail-oriented engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Responsibilities

Lead architecture, deployment, and lifecycle management of data center infrastructure components. Design and implement scalable, secure, and resilient systems in hybrid environments (on-prem and cloud). Administer and maintain enterprise Windows and Linux systems. Develop and enforce backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies. Optimize storage and compute infrastructure for high performance and cost-effectiveness. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support application needs and integration projects. Document systems designs, procedures, configurations, and provide knowledge transfer. Proactively monitor systems performance and reliability, and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Ensure compliance with industry standards and internal security policies. Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents with urgency and professionalism.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 7+ years of experience in systems engineering or infrastructure roles. Proficiency in both Windows Server and Linux (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu) environments. Proven experience in data center design, build-out, and operations. Strong knowledge of backup and disaster recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, Rubrik). Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS/AWS GovCloud, Azure, or GCP. Familiarity with enterprise storage solutions (e.g., NetApp, Dell EMC, Ceph). Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V). Strong scripting and automation skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python). Understanding of networking fundamentals and integration with infrastructure systems. Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to multitask and work under pressure.

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computerOccasional standing and walking within the officeManual dexterity to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipmentVisual acuity to read screens, documents, and reportsOccasional reaching, bending, or stooping to access file drawers, cabinets, or office suppliesLifting and carrying items up to 20 pounds occasionally (e.g., office supplies, packages)

Saronic pays 100% of the premium for employees and 80% for dependents

jobs.description:
Plan, organize, direct and control all efforts relative to the design, definition, development, implementation and maintenance of computer systems, applications, projects and programs.

This position will lead a high-performing team of managers, FTEs, and managed service partners within the End User Computing and Modern Workspace organization, which includes collaboration tools, audio/video conferencing, email and print services, and additional employee productivity applications. This mission-critical leadership role is responsible for delivering a secure, reliable, and AI-enabled environment that protects corporate information, simplifies user collaboration across digital and physical workspaces, and drives global enterprise productivity. The Managing Director will balance operational excellence with strategic transformation, ensuring the performance, stability, and supportability of the current technology ecosystem while advancing the enterprise toward a future-ready digital workplace.

Essential Functions

Lead teams responsible for IT design and maintenance. Provide strategic direction for systes and application enhancements. Lead design projects and provide information to executives. Perform other duties as assigned.
Key Responsibilities:

The ideal candidate will bring a demonstrated record of success in driving technology transformation, leading high-performing teams, delivering operational excellence, and enabling measurable business outcomes across complex enterprise environments, with responsibilities that include:

Strategic Vision & Workplace Technology Leadership: Define and execute the strategic roadmap for a secure, unified, and modern digital workplace, delivering a seamless employee experience across collaboration platforms (e.g, M365 suite), productivity tools, endpoint technologies, and physical workplace environments while aligning technology investments to business priorities.Digital Transformation & Intelligent Automation: Lead enterprise transformation initiatives by integrating employee-facing technologies with key business platforms and advancing intelligent automation, AI-powered capabilities, and agentic workflows to simplify work, improve service delivery, and increase workforce productivity.Operational Excellence & Service Reliability: Ensure the stability, performance, and resilience of critical communication, collaboration, and productivity services supporting the global enterprise. Establish operational discipline, proactive monitoring, and rapid incident response capabilities to maintain high service availability and minimize business disruption when issues occur.IT Delivery Services, Vendor Management & Financial Stewardship: Provide strategic leadership for global IT delivery services, managed service providers, and technology partners, ensuring service quality, operational effectiveness, contractual compliance, and continuous improvement while optimizing technology investments, licensing, and operating costs.Security, Risk & Compliance Leadership: Partner with Information Security and enterprise stakeholders to deliver a modern workplace environment that is secure by design, balancing user experience, operational efficiency, and productivity with enterprise security requirements, governance standards, and regulatory obligations.Enterprise Program Leadership & Systems Thinking: Lead complex, cross-functional programs with an end-to-end enterprise perspective, driving alignment across business, technology, security, and operations teams to deliver integrated solutions, accelerate value realization, and improve organizational outcomes.Adoption, Measurement & Value Realization: Establish success metrics and accountability frameworks to measure technology adoption, employee experience, operational performance, and business outcomes, ensuring enterprise investments deliver measurable value and desired organizational results.
Minimum Education

Bachelor's Degree/equivalent in computer science, math or business or related field with emphasis in a quantitative discipline.

Minimum Experience

Extensive experience in systems development including design, development, implementation and maintenance of large batch or online transaction based systems. Experience in the majority of the following: mainframe, distributed systems, client server, relational systems, transaction and message systems, embedded systems, imaging and systems management and operation.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Previous management experience, strong leadership, human relations and communication skills required.

jobs.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences.

Rithum ™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As an Automation Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the scripts, workflows, and tools that let Rithum ’s Business Technology team spend less time on manual, repetitive IT work and more time solving problems that matter. You also administer and support the end-user, identity, and collaboration platforms Rithum runs on, so the automation you build is grounded in hands-on ownership of those systems. You partner closely with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify where automation can reduce risk and free up capacity, and you are accountable for the reliability of the automation you build.

All team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, confidentiality, and compliance.

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and workflows (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) that streamline IT service delivery, endpoint provisioning, and systems administration tasks.

- Design, build, and own automated workflows across user lifecycle, device provisioning, and identity lifecycle using Rithum 's existing platforms (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf) and API and webhook integrations.

- Instrument automations with logging and alerting so every action is auditable and measurable, tracking hours saved and errors reduced rather than only whether a workflow ran.

- Translate manual, repetitive IT operations processes into reliable, documented, automated solutions, adapting existing scripts and tools to address new and evolving business needs.

- Use AI tools to accelerate script development, troubleshoot automation failures, and draft technical documentation, verifying outputs before they are applied to production systems.

Enterprise Systems Administration & Support

- Administer, configure, and monitor end-user and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf, and Tanium, escalating architectural decisions on complex integrations to senior IT Operations teammates.

- Administer and support collaboration and productivity platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams.

- Resolve end-user computing issues across Windows and macOS through the ticketing queue, direct messaging, and voice or video sessions, owning requests end-to-end and escalating critical incidents and system alerts to senior IT Operations.

- Document technical solutions so they are accurate, secure, and aligned with corporate IT and Information Security standards and policies.

- Partner with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify recurring manual tasks that are strong candidates for automation.

- Collaborate with partner teams to test, deploy, and monitor automation workflows, tailoring communication to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Provide occasional guidance to Service Desk teammates on scripting fundamentals and automation best practices as your experience grows.

Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

- Document automation workflows, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides so that solutions remain supportable and repeatable across the IT organization.

- Own the automation knowledge base, keeping runbooks and integration notes current so what you build is repeatable and supportable by others rather than dependent on you.

- Apply lessons learned from prior automation efforts to improve reliability, reduce inefficiencies, and anticipate dependencies in future builds.

- Monitor the performance and reliability of deployed automations, escalating and resolving issues within your area of ownership.

AI-Enabled Productivity & Innovation

- Use AIas your starting point for recurring IT work — configuration research, scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution design — so your output is clearer and needs less rework.

- Validate AI-generated scripts, configurations, and recommendations in non-production environments before applying them, following Rithum 's responsible AI use and data security standards.

- Share effective AI-assisted approaches and prompts with teammates when they meaningfully improve automation quality or speed.

- Continuously identify opportunities where automation and AI can be applied to Business Technology workflows, escalating larger opportunities to your manager.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in IT systems administration, service desk operations, or a related technical role, including hands-on experience writing and maintaining automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar).

- Hands-on experience administering or supporting enterprise identity, collaboration, and productivity platforms such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams.

- Demonstrated experience adapting or troubleshooting existing automation, scripts, or workflows to resolve moderately complex, ambiguous technical issues.

- Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity through research, communication, analysis, documentation, automation, workflow optimization, and decision-making.

- Demonstrated hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to build, ship, or automate a working solution, evidenced by a portfolio, repository, or project example.

- Located in the United States Central or Mountain time zone, with working hours aligned to that time zone.

- Handle escalations requiring cross-team coordination. Participate in an on-call rotation for urgent issues outside business hours.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Must be available for occasional travel to Rithum offices - anticipated quarterly.

- Successful professional experience working in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in IT automation, systems engineering, or a DevOps-adjacent role.

- Certifications such as CompTIA Server+, CompTIA Linux+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent scripting/automation certifications.

- Experience integrating automation with IT service management or endpoint management tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Jira).

- Experience with workflow orchestration or automation tooling (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato).

- Familiarity with REST API integration patterns and event-driven concepts such as webhooks, triggers, and conditional logic.

- Exposure to endpoint management and protection platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Tanium, CrowdStrike).

- Personal projects, repositories, or hackathon work demonstrating scripting or automation ability.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum , you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

- Partner with the leading brands and retailers.

- Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.

- Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.

- Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.

- Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $75,000-$115,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 10% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

- Medical, dental and vision benefits: Affordable health care plans and company HSA contributions, starting on Day 1

- A 6% 401(k) match

- Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 9 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days

- 12 weeks primary caregiver leave & 4 weeks secondary caregiver leave

- Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance

- Pet insurance

- Legal assistance and identity theft insurance plans

- Life insurance 2x salary

- Access to the Calm app and the Employee Assistance Program

- $65/month Remote work stipend for internet

- Culture and team-building activities

- Tuition assistance

- Career development opportunities

- Charitable contribution match up to $250 per year

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form. Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.

jobs.description:
Iovance Biotherapeutics aims to be the global leader in innovating, developing and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy for people with cancer.

Iovance Biotherapeutics aims to be the global leader in innovating, developing and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy for people with cancer. We are pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient. The Iovance TIL platform has demonstrated promising clinical data across multiple solid tumors. We are committed to continuous innovation in cell therapy, including gene-edited cell therapy, which may be a promising option for patients with cancer.

Overview

The Lead Endpoint Engineering Architect will own the architecture and build-out of Iovance’s endpoint management platform, covering roughly 1,000 Windows devices across corporate, lab, and field locations. This role exists to design a modern, reliable endpoint platform on Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and Entra ID, build it, document it, and hand off day-to-day operations to the existing support team with clear runbooks. This is a hands-on technical role, not a management role. The Lead Endpoint Engineering Architect will partner with IT Security, Quality Assurance, and business stakeholders across the company, but the core of the job is engineering work: designing configurations, packaging applications, writing PowerShell, testing deployments, and solving problems.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

- Own the design and implementation of our Intune and Autopilot environment end-to-end: enrollment profiles, configuration profile architecture, compliance policies, Conditional Access, and update ring strategy.

- Build Autopilot provisioning workflows that let us ship a factory-sealed laptop to any employee and have it arrive fully configured without a technician touching it. This includes selecting the right deployment modes for different device scenarios and troubleshooting the enrollment edge cases that inevitably come up.

- Create a layered configuration profile structure in Intune: security baselines that apply to everything, role-specific profiles for different groups, and exception policies where needed.

- Set up Windows Update for Business with proper ring management so updates deploy in controlled phases.

- Design and own application deployment approach using Intune’s Win32 packaging model. This means proper dependency chains, detection rules that actually verify successful installs, and a consistent test-before-deploy process. Application packaging is a significant part of this role, especially during the initial platform build-out.

- Build Proactive Remediations that detect and auto-fix common problems like dropped network drives, configuration drift, and application health issues before users have to call the help desk.

- Establish and maintain laptop performance baselines and remediation workflows — including startup time optimization, memory and CPU utilization profiling, background service rationalization, and bloatware removal — using Intune Proactive Remediations (detection + remediation script pairs), Endpoint Analytics scores, and Windows performance counters to identify degradation patterns before they generate tickets, and to enforce consistent performance standards across both hardware models.

- Work with IT Security to implement compliance policies and Conditional Access rules that give us continuous, auditable proof that our endpoints meet our security baseline.

- Write and maintain the documentation that makes this platform operable by others on the team: architecture diagrams, runbooks, application packaging standards, and troubleshooting guides.

- Train and mentor our deskside and help desk staff on Intune operations, including how to look up a device, check compliance, verify app assignments, trigger syncs, and know when to escalate.

- Evaluate endpoint management tools and technologies as needed, particularly OEM driver management solutions for our hardware fleet.

- Design, build, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, libraries, and lists that support departmental workflows. Configure site permissions, access controls, and governance policies aligned with Iovance's security and compliance requirements. Manage site lifecycle including provisioning, decommissioning, and archival. Troubleshoot site performance, broken permissions, and content issues. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional SharePoint solutions

- Develop and maintain Power Automate flows to automate business processes such as approvals, notifications, document routing, and data collection. Integrate Power Automate with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms and other M365 services. Monitor flow run history, troubleshoot failures, and optimize performance. Maintain documentation of all automated workflows including flow diagrams, trigger conditions, and error-handling logic

- Create and manage Microsoft Forms for internal data collection, surveys, and intake processes. Connect Forms to SharePoint lists and Power Automate flows for end-to-end process automation. Ensure form designs meet accessibility and usability standards

- Must adhere to Iovance Biotherapeutics ’ core values, policies, procedures, and business ethics.

- Perform miscellaneous duties as assigned.

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

- 8+ years in enterprise IT, with at least 4–5 of those years spent deep in Intune, Autopilot, Entra ID, Conditional Access, and Windows Update for Business.

- Experience architecting and operating an Intune environment managing 1,000+ devices. Understanding of profile layering, group targeting, policy conflicts, and the operational realities of managing a fleet this size, not just the theory.

- Strong PowerShell skills at a production-automation level. Experience writing scripts that run unattended across hundreds of devices, handle errors gracefully, and are maintainable by others. Proactive Remediations, device config scripts, and reporting.

- Real experience packaging Win32 applications for Intune: silent installs, detection rules, dependency chains, supersedence.

- Solid understanding of Entra ID dynamic groups, Conditional Access policy design, and how the identity, device management, and security layers interact in a Microsoft 365 environment.

- Experience managing drivers across a mixed hardware fleet using OEM tools (Dell Command Update, Lenovo System Update, HP Client Management) or Windows Update for Business driver management.

- Experience working in a regulated industry such as pharma, biotech, medical device, or financial services, where change control and documentation aren’t optional.

- Experience working across IT, security, quality, and business teams.

- Experience documenting and writing runbooks for others to follow.

Preferred Education, Skills, and Knowledge

- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) or equivalent.

- Experience migrating from SCCM/MECM to Intune, including co-management and hybrid identity scenarios.

- Familiarity with how endpoint changes map to validation and qualification requirements in regulated environments.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 E3/E5 licensing and what security, compliance, and device management capabilities come with each tier.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Physical Demands and Activities Required

The physical demands described here represent those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals to perform these functions.

- Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods

- Ability to move about within an office or remote workspace and exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally

- Visual acuity sufficient for preparing and analyzing data, viewing computer screens, and extensive reading

- Repetitive motion involving wrists, hands, and/or fingers

- Ability to communicate effectively to exchange information

- Ability to engage in analytical, conceptual, and problem‑solving activities in a dynamic business environment

Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem-solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously with a sense of urgency; and ability to meet deadlines

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional or remote office environment and requires operating standard office equipment and keyboards.

#li-remote

The annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay is listed. Individual pay decisions depend on various factors, such as primary work location, complexity and responsibility of the role, job duties/requirements, and relevant education, experience and skills.

Pay Transparency

$195,000—$210,000 USD

They are not intended to constitute a comprehensive list of functions, duties, or local variances. Management retains the discretion to add or to change the duties of the position at any time.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SECURITY ENGINEER - TOP SECRET CLEARANCE

SpaceX is looking for an IT Security Engineer with deep knowledge and broad experience across enterprise security technologies, in addition to broader experience with identity, endpoint protection, SIEM, and vulnerability management. This employee will be a member of the Information Technology team and will support SpaceX personnel and systems on classified networks. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment. They should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess the ingenuity to excel at this position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Work closely with o ther SpaceX IT administrators and engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support security solutions and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams. Build highly resilient, high-performance, scalable, and flexible systems.

- Take lessons learned and technology standards from the SpaceX Enterprise and apply them in smaller classified environments.

- Exercise a high degree of responsibility for the processes, systems, and tools you create and manage; all supporting the goal of making humanity an interplanetary species.

- Design, deploy, and operate security controls for classified corporate-style IT networks, including authentication and identity services (hardware tokens, certificate-based authentication, privileged access), on-premises SIEM for logging and detection, endpoint/host protection, and vulnerability management.

- Harden and secure traditional IT services used by engineering staff (email, file servers/shares, directory services, collaboration tools, and internal applications); review and improve permissions, group membership, and access models to reduce standing privilege.

- Partner with systems, network, and application owners to securely design, deploy, and operate applications (authentication/authorization, logging, patching, least privilege).

- Lead or support detection, triage, and incident response for the classified IT environment.

- Make recommendations, justify, and implement improvements using an accepted change control methodology .

- Work within a diverse group to design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner by interacting with internal business units.

- Define, document, and follow standards and best practices for systems design, testing, and implementation.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a MECM Engineer to support the deployment, administration, and maintenance of Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) environments for a Federal Government customer.

We are seeking a MECM Engineer to support the deployment, administration, and maintenance of Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) environments for a Federal Government customer. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing MECM infrastructure, supporting enterprise endpoint management operations, and assisting with the deployment and configuration of MECM in cloud or hybrid-cloud environments.

The MECM Engineer will support software deployment, operating system deployment, patch management, endpoint compliance, and system modernization initiatives while ensuring adherence to federal security and operational requirements.

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Technology, Infrastructure & Engineering, Health, Manufacturing, Public Safety, Consulting, and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

- Must be able to obtain and maintain the required customer clearance for access to systems, facilities, equipment and property.

- Experience supporting the deployment or implementation of MECM infrastructure, including new environment builds.

- Experience with cloud-hosted or hybrid MECM environments, preferably within Microsoft Azure or Azure Government.

- Experience with software packaging, software deployment, and operating system deployment (OSD).

- Experience administering Windows Server and Active Directory environments.

- Working knowledge of WSUS and Windows patch management processes.

- Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

- Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting Federal Government agencies.

- Experience with Cloud Management Gateway (CMG).

- Experience with Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager.

- Familiarity with Azure, Azure Government, or cloud infrastructure services.

- Knowledge of NIST 800-53, FISMA, and federal security requirements.

- Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

- Understanding of PKI and certificate-based authentication.

Preferred Certifications

- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate

- CompTIA Security+

- ITIL Foundation

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

- Administer and maintain Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) infrastructure and associated site systems.

- Support the installation, configuration, and maintenance of MECM environments, including cloud-hosted and hybrid deployments.

- Assist with the implementation and support of MECM components, including Management Points, Distribution Points, Software Update Points, and Cloud Management Gateway (CMG).

- Deploy and manage operating system deployment (OSD) task sequences and endpoint imaging solutions.

- Package, test, and deploy applications using MECM.

- Manage monthly patching activities and software updates through MECM and WSUS.

- Monitor MECM health, troubleshoot client and server issues, and resolve deployment failures.

- Support endpoint inventory, compliance reporting, and asset management activities.

- Create and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate routine administration tasks.

- Assist with MECM integration efforts involving Microsoft Intune and co-management solutions.

- Support cybersecurity and compliance initiatives in accordance with federal policies and standards.

- Develop and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and operational runbooks.

- Provide Tier II/III support for MECM-related incidents and service requests.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

- 3+ years of experience administering MECM/SCCM in an enterprise environment.

Work is primarily performed in an office environment. Regularly required to sit. ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮

Rocket Money ’s mission is to meaningfully improve the financial prosperity of millions of people. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

ABOUT THE TEAM 🤝

The Autopilot team sits within the Financial Products & Partnerships group at Rocket Money and is responsible for helping our members hit important financial milestones more easily by leveraging technology. We’re a small team of experienced builders who can balance moving quickly with operating diligently in order to responsibly manage other people’s money. After building software tools and financial products that have helped millions of people save money, we’re now building an entire ecosystem to go beyond saving money and into helping our members build lasting wealth.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:

- Make key decisions for the future of our banking and investment systems that balance technical concerns with business concerns.

- Build user interfaces using React and build back-ends in Node & GraphQL.

- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand nuanced business needs and communicate technical complexity and tradeoffs clearly when requirements evolve.

- You're both a student and a teacher, continually seeking to grow as an engineer and help those around you grow as well.

jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is looking for an IT Systems Engineer to lead the technical side of integrating newly acquired companies into Lyft's IT environment. You'll be responsible for migrating collaboration tools, SaaS platforms, and identity systems from acquired teams into Lyft's stack, with minimal disruption to either side. We're looking for a self-starter who's equally comfortable driving projects independently and partnering with others to get things done. The ideal candidate brings strong attention to detail, creative problem-solving, and a genuine drive to automate processes and improve efficiency across the IT organization.

Responsibilities:

- Manage SaaS integration and consolidation during merger and acquisition activity, ensuring smooth platform migrations, data integrity, and minimal disruption across merged organizations

- Provide architectural, engineering, and operational support for corporate IT systems at Lyft

- Support single sign on integrations with Lyft’s primary identity provider, Okta.

- Leverage various APIs to write scripts and applications to automate IT Operations

- Support and work with IT, Security and other internal departments by building automation for repetitive tasks

- Write detailed and concise documentation and runbooks

- Engage with vendors to implement and improve services to best support Lyft’s needs

- Be a mentor to others in IT and act as a source for others

Experience & Skills:

- 5+ years of experience managing corporate IT Systems

- Proven experience supporting IT integration during mergers, acquisitions, or divestitures, including SaaS platform consolidation and system migrations

- SaaS system application management including but not limited to: Gsuite, Okta, Atlassian, Slack

- Scripting experience leveraging GAM, Python, Bash, and/or equivalent tools

- Comfortable consuming REST APIs

- Experience administering Okta via Terraform

- Experience with GitOps

- Familiarity with open ID connect, SAML, and Oauth is required.

- Experience building integrations across various systems leveraging APIs with both low code/no code solutions using platforms like Okta workflows and Workato

- Experience writing and documenting detailed project proposals

- Experience working with vendors to solve issues, project roadmaps, and implement improvements

- Ability to adapt and solve problems in a fast moving environment

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to collaborate and work with others

Nice to have:

- Experience with monitoring, we use Panther

- Experience with AWS, GCP

- Experience working with Workday and/or other ERP systems

- Experience with MDMs, jamf, NinjaOne, Omnissa

Benefits:

- Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits

- Mental health benefits

- Family building benefits

- Child care and pet benefits

- Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account

- RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

- In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service

- Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.

- Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. jobs.description:

Kwik Trip’s IT End User Services team is seeking an Endpoint Engineer I to help ensure our enterprise endpoints remain secure, compliant, and reliable. In this role, you’ll support the testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of applications and Windows updates while collaborating closely with Endpoint Engineering, IT Security, and Service Desk teams.

This position is ideal for an early- to mid-career IT professional who enjoys hands‑on technical work, problem-solving, and contributing to large-scale endpoint operations in a fast‑paced, operational environment.

What you’ll be doing:

Own and manage Windows update processes to ensure enterprise devices remain compliant with organizational patching standards.
Monitor endpoint inventory to ensure devices are properly onboarded, maintained, and retired within management systems.
Coordinate deployment of new and updated applications that have been packaged, reviewed, and approved for production use.
Build, update, and test less complex application packages and support manual installation processes when automation is not feasible.
Manage and maintain application pilot groups to validate updates across diverse hardware, software, and job roles.
Serve as an application owner and subject matter expert for assigned platforms, supporting configuration, updates, and ongoing operations.
Identify, test, and deploy software and firmware updates to remediate defects, address security vulnerabilities, and maintain vendor supportability.
Design, build, and maintain endpoint health, compliance, patching, and security reports.
Respond to endpoint-related incidents, deployment failures, and alerts by performing root cause analysis and coordinating remediation.
Support vulnerability management and audit activities by providing accurate endpoint data, documentation, and evidence.
Maintain clear, accurate technical documentation, standards, and procedures to support operational consistency and scalability.
Collaborate closely with Endpoint Engineering, IT Security, Service Desk, Desktop Support, and other IT teams to deliver reliable endpoint services.

You’ll need to have…
Education

Associate’s degree in information systems or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and hands‑on experience in IT or endpoint management fields.

Experience

Endpoint Administration: 1‑3 years of experience managing endpoints in an enterprise environment.

Skills

Experience with enterprise endpoint management tools (e.g., SCCM, device management, patching, or other deployment platforms).
Experience supporting Windows client operating systems in an enterprise environment.
Working knowledge of endpoint management, patching, and application deployment concepts.
Experience following structured change management and documentation practices.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to perform root cause analysis.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, operational environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non‑technical teams.
High attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate system data and documentation.
Ability to work independently while also contributing as part of a collaborative team.

Physical Requirements
The ability to lift up to 50 lbs. as needed.

Advanced experience with enterprise endpoint management tools such as SCCM.
Experience supporting application lifecycle management, including testing, piloting, and upgrades.
Familiarity with vulnerability management, security remediation, or compliance frameworks.
Experience supporting audits such as PCI, security reviews, or vulnerability assessments.
Knowledge of ITIL concepts or structured IT service management practices.

Work Schedule

Monday through Friday, daytime business hours.
Participation in a rotating on‑call schedule for evenings and weekends as needed.

jobs.summary: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate...
jobs.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

**Overview**

As an Automation Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the scripts, workflows, and tools that let Rithum’s Business Technology team spend less time on manual, repetitive IT work and more time solving problems that matter. You also administer and support the end-user, identity, and collaboration platforms Rithum runs on, so the automation you build is grounded in hands-on ownership of those systems. You partner closely with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify where automation can reduce risk and free up capacity, and you are accountable for the reliability of the automation you build.

All team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, confidentiality, and compliance.

**Responsibilities**

Automation Development & Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and workflows (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) that streamline IT service delivery, endpoint provisioning, and systems administration tasks.
- Design, build, and own automated workflows across user lifecycle, device provisioning, and identity lifecycle using Rithum's existing platforms (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf) and API and webhook integrations.
- Instrument automations with logging and alerting so every action is auditable and measurable, tracking hours saved and errors reduced rather than only whether a workflow ran.
- Translate manual, repetitive IT operations processes into reliable, documented, automated solutions, adapting existing scripts and tools to address new and evolving business needs.
- Use AI tools to accelerate script development, troubleshoot automation failures, and draft technical documentation, verifying outputs before they are applied to production systems.

Enterprise Systems Administration & Support

- Administer, configure, and monitor end-user and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf, and Tanium, escalating architectural decisions on complex integrations to senior IT Operations teammates.
- Administer and support collaboration and productivity platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams.
- Resolve end-user computing issues across Windows and macOS through the ticketing queue, direct messaging, and voice or video sessions, owning requests end-to-end and escalating critical incidents and system alerts to senior IT Operations.
- Document technical solutions so they are accurate, secure, and aligned with corporate IT and Information Security standards and policies.
- Partner with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify recurring manual tasks that are strong candidates for automation.
- Collaborate with partner teams to test, deploy, and monitor automation workflows, tailoring communication to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Provide occasional guidance to Service Desk teammates on scripting fundamentals and automation best practices as your experience grows.

Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

- Document automation workflows, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides so that solutions remain supportable and repeatable across the IT organization.
- Own the automation knowledge base, keeping runbooks and integration notes current so what you build is repeatable and supportable by others rather than dependent on you.
- Apply lessons learned from prior automation efforts to improve reliability, reduce inefficiencies, and anticipate dependencies in future builds.
- Monitor the performance and reliability of deployed automations, escalating and resolving issues within your area of ownership.

AI-Enabled Productivity & Innovation

- Continuously identify opportunities where automation and AI can be applied to Business Technology workflows, escalating larger opportunities to your manager.

**Qualifications**

Minimum Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in IT systems administration, service desk operations, or a related technical role, including hands-on experience writing and maintaining automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar).
- Hands-on experience administering or supporting enterprise identity, collaboration, and productivity platforms such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams.

- Handle escalations requiring cross-team coordination. Participate in an on-call rotation for urgent issues outside business hours.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Must be available for occasional travel to Rithum offices - anticipated quarterly.
- Successful professional experience working in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in IT automation, systems engineering, or a DevOps-adjacent role.
- Certifications such as CompTIA Server+, CompTIA Linux+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent scripting/automation certifications.
- Experience integrating automation with IT service management or endpoint management tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Jira).
- Experience with workflow orchestration or automation tooling (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato).
- Familiarity with REST API integration patterns and event-driven concepts such as webhooks, triggers, and conditional logic.
- Exposure to endpoint management and protection platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Tanium, CrowdStrike).
- Personal projects, repositories, or hackathon work demonstrating scripting or automation ability.

**What it’s like to work at Rithum**

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

jobs.description:
Job Description
We offer a competitive salary for this role, with an expected range of $70,600 to $89,400. The final offer will depend on your experience, skills, and overall qualifications. General Dynamics – Bath Iron Works also provides a variety of benefits including medical & dental insurance coverage, 401(k) retirement savings plan, flexible spending accounts/HSAs, life and disability insurance, company paid holidays, paid time off (PTO), health coaching, athletic trainers, employee assistance programs and onsite health services.

As part of the Endpoint Engineer team, the Endpoint Engineer III builds, administers, and maintains the client endpoint and mobile environment for Bath Iron Works under the direction of the Sr. Endpoint Engineer. The role executes established build standards and images, administers enterprise endpoint management tooling and mobile device management (MDM), develops PowerShell automation for defined tasks, and implements endpoint security configurations.

The Endpoint Engineer III serves as an L3 escalation point for the desktop and mobility technicians on documented complex issues and partners with the Infrastructure, Security, and Service Desk teams on project execution. Operating under the BIW Business Operating System (BOS), the Endpoint Engineer III ensures compliance with safety, quality, and performance standards while coordinating with other key stakeholders to meet overall milestones.

Key Responsibilities

Safety Leadership:

Comply with all BIW safety and security standards while working across office, manufacturing, and shipboard environments.
Implement endpoint configurations that uphold BIW security and data-protection requirements, and follow established procedures when handling hardware, media, and sensitive data.

Project Execution:

Build and maintain client device images and standard build configurations for laptops, desktops, and mobile devices under the direction of the senior Endpoint Engineer.
Administer enterprise endpoint management tooling (e.g., MCM) and MDM platforms for software deployment, patching, compliance reporting, and mobile device policy execution.
Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate defined deployment, update, and endpoint administration tasks.
Implement endpoint security configurations in alignment with BIW security policy, including antivirus, encryption, patching, and vulnerability remediation activities.
Support endpoint lifecycle management activity, including hardware refresh execution and operating system upgrades across the estate.
Other duties as assigned.

Training and Development:

Maintain and document working knowledge of endpoint platforms, management tools, and security practices. Pursue and obtain relevant certifications.
Provide L3 guidance to the desktop and mobility technicians on documented issue types and grow technical depth under the mentorship of the senior Endpoint Engineer.

Team Collaboration and Communication:

Serve as L3 escalation for documented complex hardware, operating system, and application issues raised by Desktop Technician II; escalate architecture-level or undocumented issues to the senior Endpoint Engineer.
Partner with the Infrastructure, Security, and Service Desk teams on assigned project execution and cross-team incident resolution.
Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to technicians, peer IT teams, and stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement:

Identify opportunities to automate manual processes encountered during routine work and propose them for prioritization with the senior Endpoint Engineer.
Contribute to technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles for endpoint tooling and procedures.

Required/Preferred Education/Training
Required:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Preferred:

Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Microsoft endpoint/Windows certifications (e.g., MD-102 Endpoint Administrator) and other relevant industry certifications.

Required/Preferred Experience
Required:

Must be able to satisfy BIW background-check and site-access requirements.
2–4 years of endpoint administration, senior desktop, or entry-level endpoint engineering experience in an enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience administering an enterprise endpoint management platform (e.g., MCM), including image build, software deployment, patching, and compliance reporting.
Working proficiency in PowerShell for endpoint automation, and working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, and identity management.
Working understanding of core networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN) and endpoint security concepts (encryption, MFA, patching, and vulnerability remediation).

Preferred:

Exposure to cloud-based endpoint management (Intune/Autopilot) and Entra ID, MDM administration, ServiceNow, Jira, and experience in a defense, manufacturing, or other regulated environment.

jobs.description:
Imagine yourself…• Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.

Imagine yourself…

- Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.

- Collaborating with a vibrant, inclusive, global team.

- Joining a company with a proven track record of success and an exciting future.

At Veralto , our unifying purpose of Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™ is more than words: it’s a proven path towards positive change, improvement for our planet, and development for yourself.

Whether we’re ensuring the continued availability of clean drinking water, protecting our waterways, or enhancing the traceability, color accuracy, and packaging of everyday essentials, the work we do every day contributes to a safer world and a more sustainable future.

When you join Veralto ’s vibrant global network of 13 operating companies and 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility : where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have boundless opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career.

At Veralto we are seeking a Systems Engineer to join our global infrastructure team and help us deliver secure, scalable, and reliable technology platforms across our Operating Companies. This role is central to ensuring that our enterprise systems and cloud environments run seamlessly, enabling innovation and operational excellence.

This position is part of Veralto ’s global IT organization, will be remote , and offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment where collaboration and innovation drive our success. Bring your passion for technology and join us in shaping the future of our infrastructure.

In this role, you will:

- Design, deploy, and operate Microsoft Azure environments, including management of multiple subscriptions and contributing to multi‑tenant architecture

- Support and evolve enterprise systems architectures and standards that ensure scalability, security, and operational consistency

- Administer and support Windows Server environments, including deployment, patching, lifecycle management, and architecture support

- Operate and maintain Microsoft SCCM and SCOM for systems management, monitoring, and visibility

- Support endpoint and device management solutions using Microsoft Intune, MDM, and JAMF

- Provide operational support for enterprise endpoint access and remote support tools such as Bomgar

- Support and maintain DNS services (internal and external) and SFTP platforms supporting business and application integrations

- Implement and support Azure Arc for hybrid and non‑Azure resource visibility and management

- Partner with Security teams to deploy, monitor, and operationalize Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel

- Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform to automate and standardize platform deployments

- Execute systems‑focused projects across Veralto Operating Companies under guidance from senior engineers or architects

- Document system configurations, standards, and operational procedures

- Collaborate closely with Network, Security, and Cloud Architecture teams to ensure aligned and reliable infrastructure services

The essential requirements of the job include:

- 5+ years of relevant experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Platform Engineering roles

- Hands‑on experience supporting Microsoft Azure environments, including subscription‑level management

- Strong experience administering Windows Server in enterprise or cloud‑integrated environments

- Experience operating Microsoft SCCM, SCOM, and Intune

- Practical experience with endpoint management, including MDM solutions and JAMF

- Experience supporting enterprise security platforms such as Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel

- Working knowledge of Azure Arc and hybrid systems management concepts

- Experience supporting DNS (internal and external) and managed file transfer platforms (SFTP)

- Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code, including Terraform and scripting (PowerShell preferred)

- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to resolve complex systems issues in production environments

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a global infrastructure team

Preferred Qualifications:

- Relevant industry certifications (cloud, security, systems, automation, or platform technologies)

- Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience considered

- Experience working in large enterprise or multi‑OpCo environments

- Experience supporting infrastructure platforms during M&A, carve‑out, or organizational change

- Comfortable operating in environments with high autonomy and loosely defined problem spaces

- Proactive use of AI tools and an AI‑first mindset, leveraging modern AI capabilities to improve productivity, speed of execution, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem‑solving

-
Self‑starter mentality : Proactively identify gaps and improvement opportunities, independently research and implement solutions without waiting for detailed instructions, and actively reduce operational burdens to enhance overall team effectiveness.

With annual sales of $5 billion, Veralto is a global leader in essential technology solutions with a proven track record of solving some of the most complex challenges we face as a society. Our industry-leading companies with globally recognized brands are building on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future.

Veralto ’s Water Quality companies—Aquatic Informatics, ChemTreat, Hach, McCrometer, OTT HydroMet, Sea-Bird Scientific, Trojan Technologies, and XOS—manage, treat, purify, and protect the global water supply, from municipal and wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans. And our Product Quality & Innovation companies—Esko, Linx, Pantone, Videojet, and X-Rite—protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials by tracking and authenticating the billions of goods that travel the global supply chain every day. Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, with 300+ locations worldwide.

At Veralto , we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.
