jobs.description:
Overview

The Systems Engineer III – Endpoint Management is a hands-on engineering role responsible for the day-to-day management, configuration, and continuous improvement of Sprouts’ corporate and retail endpoint fleet across Windows and macOS. Working within a small, high-impact endpoint team, this engineer builds and maintains device configuration, application deployment, patching, and compliance across Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM), Tanium, and Kandji.

This is an execution-focused engineering role. Endpoint strategy and platform direction are set in partnership with the Systems Engineering Supervisor and senior engineers; this position contributes technical recommendations, owns the build and rollout, and serves as an escalation point for the service desk.

The role reports to our Store Support Office in Phoenix, AZ, with a hybrid work arrangement requiring in-office presence Tuesday through Thursday.

Overview of Responsibilities

Build, deploy, and maintain device configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines across Windows and macOS using Microsoft Intune and Kandji. Administer Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM) for the existing store and corporate Windows support the ongoing migration of those devices to Intune and Windows Autopilot. Manage zero-touch enrollment programs including Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager (ABM/DEP), including hardware hash management, enrollment status pages, and vendor drop-ship coordination. Own operating system patching and feature update campaigns using Tanium and Intune update rings, including ring design, pilot validation, phased rollout across time zones, communication, and rollback planning. Package, test, and deploy applications and application updates across Windows and macOS using Tanium, Intune, Patch My PC, and Kandji, favoring automated role-based assignment over manual installation. Develop and maintain PowerShell automation for endpoint lifecycle tasks including remediation scripts, reporting, bulk operations, and Microsoft Graph API interactions. Configure and maintain endpoint security controls including disk encryption, local administrator management, certificate deployment, and CIS benchmark enforcement in partnership with the Information Security team. Support Conditional Access and device compliance policy configuration within Microsoft Entra ID, ensuring devices meet posture requirements before accessing corporate resources. Diagnose and resolve escalated tier 3 endpoint incidents spanning hardware, operating system, application, and management-policy layers; perform root cause analysis and implement preventive fixes. Create and maintain operational documentation including enrollment procedures, policy configurations, deployment runbooks, and knowledge base articles for the service desk. Serve as a technical escalation point for the service desk and provide coaching and knowledge transfer to support staff and junior engineers. Participate in a rotating on-call schedule providing first-line tier 3 support for server and infrastructure issues. Support off-hours deployment windows as required for retail store maintenance across multiple time zones. Evaluate new endpoint tooling and capabilities through proof-of-concept work and provide recommendations to the Systems Engineering Supervisor and senior engineers.
Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience. 3+ years in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, or device management roles within an enterprise environment. Hands-on proficiency with Microsoft Intune, including configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, and update rings. Working experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) for software distribution, operating system deployment, or patch management. Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot enrollment, including hardware hash collection, deployment profiles, and Enrollment Status Page configuration. Proficiency in PowerShell for endpoint automation, scripting, and reporting; ability to write and troubleshoot scripts independently. Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, and device compliance concepts. Experience planning and executing patching or operating system upgrade campaigns across a distributed device fleet. Familiarity with endpoint security frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks and standard patch management practices. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred

Experience with Tanium for patching, software deployment, or compliance enforcement. Experience managing macOS endpoints through Kandji, Jamf, or a comparable Apple MDM platform, including Apple Business Manager. Experience supporting endpoints in a retail, distributed-site, or multi-time-zone environment. Experience with third-party patching platforms such as Patch My PC. Familiarity with ChromeOS device management and kiosk configuration. Additional scripting experience with Bash, Python, or Microsoft Graph API. Exposure to Microsoft 365, Windows Server, or VMware vSphere administration. Relevant certifications such as Microsoft MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator Associate), AZ-104, or Apple/Kandji certifications. Core Competencies

Execution and Follow-Through: Delivers work that is tested, documented, and complete; sets measurable goals and pursues them with a sense of urgency. Automation Mindset: Looks for repetitive manual work and eliminates it through scripting, policy, and process improvement. Security Orientation: Integrates security thinking into every aspect of device and application lifecycle management. Customer Focus: Prioritizes end-user experience and business needs while maintaining security and compliance standards. Communication: Clearly conveys technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; actively listens and collaborates across teams. Positive Approach: Demonstrates a constructive attitude in challenging situations and inspires others with a forward-looking outlook. Work Environment

Hybrid schedule based out of the Sprouts Store Support Office in Phoenix, Arizona, with in-office presence Tuesday through Thursday. Participation in a rotating on-call schedule of approximately one week in eight. Availability for off-hours and weekend maintenance windows supporting retail store deployments across multiple time zones. Occasional travel to retail locations or distribution centers may be required.

Competitive paySick time plan that you can use to support you or your immediate families healthVacation accrual planOpportunities for career growth15% discount for you and one other family member in your household on all purchases made at SproutsFlexible schedulesEmployee Assistance Program (EAP)401(K) Retirement savings plan with a generous company matchCompany paid life insuranceContests and appreciation events throughout the year full of prizes, food and fun!Eligibility requirements may apply for the following benefits:

jobs.description:
Job Description

Microsoft 365 and Endpoint Administrator
You Are
You are a hands-on, detail-oriented technology professional who takes ownership of Microsoft 365, Intune, and Entra ID environments. You thrive in fast-paced environments where security, reliability, and operational efficiency matter. You are skilled at managing endpoint policies, application deployments, device provisioning, identity and access, and Microsoft 365 services. Your proactive mindset, strong troubleshooting abilities, and automation-first approach help you identify issues before they impact users. You communicate clearly, document your work thoroughly, collaborate effectively across IT and security teams, and continuously look for ways to simplify, standardize, and improve the organization’s technology environment.
We Are

Compugen Systems, Inc. (CSI,) an affiliate of Compugen Inc., is an IT service delivery company that focuses on the business outcome of technology. We improve the human experience as organizations work to design, acquire, integrate, and operate technology for productivity improvement and competitive advantage. CSI provides innovative technology-based services to accelerate your transformation in the Modern Workspace and Hybrid IT with our uniquely crafted managed, professional, and field services. At CSI, we believe that every day we have, is another opportunity to innovate, inspire, and impact the world for the better. Our vision is to redefine customer experience, join us.

What We Need
We are looking for an experienced and solutions-oriented Microsoft 365 Administrator / Endpoint Administrator to join our team in a full-time, hourly, onsite position. The ideal candidate will have 2–3+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Windows endpoints. This is a hands-on onsite platform administration role. The successful candidate will be responsible for configuring, deploying, securing, troubleshooting, and maintaining Microsoft 365 and endpoint technologies while working closely with IT, Security, Network, vendors, and business teams. The role requires regular onsite presence to support endpoint deployments, device provisioning, hardware refreshes, troubleshooting, project rollouts, and other operational activities.
A Typical Day looks like

A typical day is focused on administering, securing, maintaining, and improving the Microsoft 365 and endpoint environment. This is a hands-on platform administration role, with most work performed through Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Intune, Entra ID, PowerShell, and ServiceNow.

Start the day by reviewing the environment: Check Intune device compliance, enrollment status, application deployment failures, security alerts, and Microsoft 365 service health.

Manage endpoints in Intune: Review Windows and iOS/iPadOS devices, troubleshoot enrollment and compliance issues, update configuration policies, and ensure devices meet organizational security requirements.

Deploy and manage applications: Package Win32/MSI applications, create detection and requirement rules, test deployments, and assign applications to the appropriate groups.

Manage Windows Autopilot: Configure and troubleshoot device provisioning, deployment profiles, enrollment status, and standardized Windows deployments.

Administer Entra ID: Create and manage users and groups, maintain dynamic group membership rules, manage MFA and access, and support identity-related administration.

Administer Microsoft 365: Manage Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, permissions, and licensing from the appropriate admin centers.

Automate repetitive tasks: Use PowerShell and Microsoft Graph to automate provisioning, licensing, reporting, device operations, and other administrative activities.

Manage ITSM activities: Review and work on ServiceNow incidents, requests, and changes while maintaining accurate asset and CMDB records.

Work with security teams: Assist with endpoint security, Microsoft Defender, compliance requirements, patching, and vulnerability remediation.

Support projects and rollouts: Participate in application deployments, hardware refreshes, Windows upgrades, migrations, Autopilot implementations, and Microsoft 365 platform improvements.

Document the environment: Update runbooks, SOPs, knowledge articles, configuration documentation, and deployment procedures.

How You’ll be Measured

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to keep the Microsoft 365 and endpoint environment secure, reliable, compliant, and well-managed, while continuously improving efficiency through automation.

Microsoft 365 Platform Health – Maintain reliable operation of Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Microsoft 365 services with minimal configuration-related issues.
Intune & Endpoint Compliance – Maintain high device enrollment and compliance rates, resolve policy and deployment failures, and ensure endpoints meet organizational security standards.
Application Deployment Success – Successfully package, test, and deploy Win32/MSI applications with accurate detection, requirement, and assignment rules.
Windows Autopilot Performance – Deliver consistent and reliable device provisioning with minimal manual intervention.
Identity & Access Management – Accurately manage Entra ID users, groups, dynamic membership, MFA, licensing, and role-based access while following security best practices.
Security & Compliance – Support timely remediation of endpoint vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance issues in coordination with the security team.
Automation & Efficiency – Develop and maintain PowerShell/Graph automation that reduces repetitive manual work and improves administrative efficiency.
ITSM & Operational Excellence – Manage ServiceNow incidents, requests, and changes within expected service levels while maintaining accurate asset and CMDB information.
Documentation Quality – Maintain current SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation so processes are repeatable and supportable.
Project Delivery – Successfully support Microsoft 365, Intune, endpoint, migration, hardware refresh, and platform improvement projects within agreed timelines.
Problem Solving – Identify root causes rather than simply resolving individual symptoms and implement sustainable platform-level solutions.
Cross-Team Collaboration – Work effectively with Security, Network, IT, vendors, and business teams to deliver reliable technology solutions.

Required Skills + Competencies

The ideal candidate combines hands-on Microsoft 365 and endpoint administration skills with strong troubleshooting, automation, security, and communication abilities.

Microsoft 365 Administration

Hands-on administration of Microsoft 365 tenant environments.
Experience with Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
Microsoft 365 licensing and user administration.
Ability to manage permissions, access, and tenant-level configurations.
Understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance fundamentals.

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune administration.
Ability to create and manage configuration profiles and compliance policies.
Windows and iOS/iPadOS device enrollment and management.
Application packaging and deployment using Win32/MSI.
Experience creating application detection, requirement, and assignment rules.
Ability to manage Required and Available application deployments.
Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot.
Understanding of endpoint patching, vulnerability management, and device lifecycle management.

Entra ID & Identity Management

Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Entra ID.
User and group management.
Dynamic groups and membership rules.
MFA configuration and administration.
Role-based access control and identity security.
Understanding of hybrid identity with on-premises Active Directory.

PowerShell & Automation

Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
Experience using Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK and Exchange Online PowerShell.
Ability to develop scripts for:

User provisioning
Licensing
Reporting
Device management
Administrative tasks

An automation-first mindset with the ability to identify and eliminate repetitive manual processes.

Security & Compliance

Security-conscious approach to Microsoft 365 and endpoint administration.
Basic experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Familiarity with Microsoft Purview and Microsoft 365 compliance capabilities.
Understanding of endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, patch management, and access controls.

ITSM & Operational Management

Experience with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform.
Ability to manage incidents, service requests, and changes.
Asset and CMDB/Configuration Item management.
Experience creating operational reports and dashboards.
Strong understanding of ITIL-based processes is a plus.

Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to identify root causes rather than simply resolving symptoms.
Comfortable troubleshooting issues across Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, applications, devices, and identity.
Ability to translate technical issues into practical solutions.

Documentation & Communication

Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to create clear SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Security, Network, IT, vendors, and business teams.

Desired Character + Culture Traits

Equal Employment Opportunity
Compugen Systems, Inc. (CSI) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Ownership & Accountability – Takes responsibility and delivers results.
Proactive Mindset – Identifies issues and improvements before they become problems.
Security-Conscious – Prioritizes security, compliance, and data protection.
Automation-Driven – Looks for opportunities to simplify and automate repetitive tasks.
Problem Solver – Thinks analytically and focuses on root-cause solutions.
Collaborative Communicator – Works effectively with teams and communicates clearly.
Continuous Learner – Keeps up with evolving Microsoft technologies and best practices.

As a Sr. Security Engineer (Trellix) I, you'll serve as the technical lead for the organization's endpoint security and data protection ecosystem, balancing day-to-day operational support with strategic cybersecurity engineering initiatives. You will work closely with security operations, infrastructure, application teams, and leadership to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.

We know that you can't have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

What you'll do:

Monitoring and managing enterprise Trellix security platforms, including ePO, ENS, EDR, DLP, and encryption technologies.Supporting SOC analysts by tuning alerts, improving detection capabilities, and investigating endpoint security events.Remediating JCIP and compliance findings through application whitelisting, File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), DLP enhancements, and security control implementations; designing and deploying endpoint hardening and application control solutions using Trellix Application and Change Control (Solidcore).Developing and maintaining DLP policies, encryption controls, removable media protections, and data classification safeguards; integrating endpoint security telemetry into SIEM and SOAR platforms to improve visibility, detection, and automated response capabilities.Performing root-cause analysis of security incidents, policy conflicts, and endpoint management issues; developing automation workflows and operational efficiencies using scripts, APIs, and orchestration tools.Creating and maintaining dashboards, reports, and metrics to support cybersecurity operations and executive reporting; collaborating with security assessors and compliance teams to implement and validate technical controls.Documenting security architectures, SOPs, playbooks, and engineering standards; researching emerging threats, evaluating new security capabilities, and recommending improvements to strengthen enterprise cyber defenses.What you'll need to succeed:

Active TS/SCI security clearance.5+ years of experience administering and engineering Trellix security solutions in a large enterprise environment.Hands-on experience with Trellix ePolicy Orchestrator (ePO), Endpoint Security (ENS), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Drive Encryption (FRP/FRMP), Threat Intelligence Exchange (TIE), Data Exchange Layer (DXL), Policy Auditor, Rogue System Detection, Trellix Security for Microsoft Exchange (TSME), Application and Change Control (Solidcore), and File Integrity Monitoring (FIM).Experience implementing and managing application whitelisting, endpoint hardening, encryption, and data protection technologies; integrating endpoint security platforms with SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, and identity management solutions.Strong understanding of endpoint security architecture, cyber threat detection, incident response, and risk management principles; experience developing and maintaining DLP policies, device control mechanisms, and data exfiltration prevention controls.Experience supporting SOCs and enhancing 24x7 threat monitoring and response capabilities; ability to develop security engineering standards, SOPs, playbooks, and operational procedures.Experience supporting compliance initiatives and implementing security controls aligned with federal cybersecurity frameworks and regulations; strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.SALARY RANGE: $138,000 - $166,000

The candidate's professional background and relevant work experienceThe specific responsibilities of the role and organizational needsInternal equity and alignment with current team compensationThis role is also eligible for additional compensation, subject to the terms and policies of MetroStar, which may include:Performance-based bonusesCompany-paid training and/or certificationsReferral bonuses

jobs.description:
The Digital Workplace Services (DWS) Architect will play a critical role in advancing Milestone Technologies' portfolio of offerings for our global customers. This is a **deeply technical, builder-oriented role** that fuses classic digital workplace expertise with modern software engineering and agentic AI. As the digital workplace evolves toward a **Software-as-a-Service and "Service-as-Software" mindset**, this individual must not only architect end-user computing environments but also design, prototype, and ship the software and AI agents that automate and transform them.

Leveraging deep technical expertise, hands-on development skills, and a consultative approach, this person will drive digital transformation initiatives, build automation and agentic workflows, optimize end-user computing environments, and ensure modern, secure, high-performing digital experiences. You will collaborate with C-level stakeholders, engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to create roadmap strategies, working prototypes, solution proposals, and transformation plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

- **Architecture & Strategy** Develop target reference architectures and transformation roadmaps for digital workplace solutions spanning support services, Cloud/SaaS integrations, low-code/pro-code platforms, and agentic AI. Design software-centric solutions that treat workplace services as products — APIs, microservices, and AI agents rather than manual runbooks. Partner with senior leadership to assess current IT landscapes, identify capability gaps, and propose forward-thinking strategies aligned with customer business goals.
- **Software & Agentic AI Development** Design and build production-grade software components: services, integrations, and internal tooling that power the digital workplace. Architect and implement **agentic AI systems** — LLM-orchestrated agents, tool/function calling, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as MCP (Model Context Protocol), LangChain/LangGraph, or equivalent. Containerize and deploy services using **Docker** (and orchestration via Kubernetes where appropriate); design data layers on **PostgreSQL** and comparable relational/vector stores. Write, review, and maintain clean, well-tested code (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and/or Go) and stand up CI/CD pipelines.
- **Technical Leadership & Solution Design** Drive high-level and detailed solution designs covering endpoint management, automation tooling, DEX insights, and AI-driven experience layers. Conduct performance analysis and capacity planning across Windows, Mac, and mobile environments to ensure robust, cost-effective solutions. Design APIs and integration patterns (REST, webhooks, event-driven) that connect ITSM platforms, identity providers, and third-party SaaS.
- **Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement** Act as a trusted advisor to executives and clients — often up to CEO level — translating complex technical and AI concepts into clear business value. Work closely with internal Sales, Service Delivery, and engineering teams and external vendors to ensure solutions meet technical and financial objectives.
- **Service & Portfolio Development** Contribute to new **Service-as-Software** offerings that embed automation, agentic AI, security, and collaboration into the digital workplace. Lead and mentor engineering teams, provide hands-on technical guidance during implementations, and champion best practices in agile delivery, ITSM/ITIL, and software quality.
- **Implementation & Delivery Oversight** Oversee end-to-end execution from proof-of-concept to production rollout, ensuring alignment with architecture and coding standards. Conduct root cause analyses, troubleshoot critical issues, and deliver stable, enterprise-grade solutions.
- **Security & Compliance** Integrate security into all aspects of the ecosystem, following ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent frameworks — including secure coding practices, secrets management, and AI/LLM safety and data-governance controls. Ensure adherence to compliance and governance protocols, including identity and access management best practices.
- **Continuous Improvement & Thought Leadership** Stay current on emerging technologies — agentic AI, GCP, AI-based DEX, virtualization — and incorporate relevant innovations into offerings. Evangelize and lead workshops/training to upskill teams and foster a culture of innovation.

**Required Skills & Experience**

- **Software Development (core requirement)** Proven hands-on coding ability in Python and at least one of JavaScript/TypeScript or Go, with sound software-engineering fundamentals (version control/Git, testing, CI/CD, code review). Experience with **Docker** and containerized deployment; familiarity with orchestration (Kubernetes). Strong database skills including **PostgreSQL** (schema design, query optimization) and exposure to vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, or similar). API design and integration experience (REST, GraphQL, webhooks, event-driven architectures).
- **Agentic AI & Applied ML** Demonstrated experience building LLM-powered and **agentic AI** applications: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, RAG, and agent orchestration. Familiarity with agent frameworks and standards (MCP, LangChain/LangGraph, or equivalent) and major model providers/APIs. Understanding of AI safety, evaluation, cost/latency trade-offs, and responsible-AI governance.
- **Digital Workplace & Architecture** Proven ability to define and deliver complex digital workplace architectures spanning cloud, devices, applications, and security. Strong end-user computing background (Windows, Mac, Mobile), endpoint management (SCCM, Intune, Jamf), and virtualization (AVD, Citrix).
- **Automation & Performance Analysis** Hands-on scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python), DEX tools, and performance analyzers.
- **Collaboration Platforms & Integration** Google Workspace (advanced admin, APIs, scripting) or Office 365, including identity management (SSO, SCIM). Cloud identity platforms (Okta, Azure AD) and third-party app integration.
- **Leadership & Stakeholder Management** Experience leading cross-functional/engineering teams and driving transformation from concept to production. Excellent communication skills; able to mentor engineers, influence C-level executives, and facilitate cross-org collaboration.
- **Project & Service Management** Agile methodology, ITSM/ITIL, change management, and vendor/partner management. Skilled in building business cases, writing proposals, and estimating timelines and costs.
- **Education & Certification** Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; TOGAF or similar architecture certifications a plus. 6+ years across Digital Workplace, IT Architecture, End-User Computing, **and/or software engineering**, with demonstrable coding experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Cloud engineering certifications (GCP, Azure, or AWS) and infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform).
- Experience shipping AI/ML or agentic products to production.
- Security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2); zero-trust architecture or advanced MDM.
- Exposure to technology, retail, financial services, or regulated environments.
- Adaptability, problem-solving, and a natural inclination to build and innovate; comfortable leading workshops and presenting at all levels.

**Job Description** **POSITION SUMMARY** The MDM (Master Data Management) Operational Lead is responsible for managing and directing the day-to-day activities of the MDM Operational Analysts and MDM Materials Management Analysts across a regional portfolio of four manufacturing plants. This role ensures consistency in execution, adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and alignment of revision changeover processes across all assigned sites. The Lead drives cross-functional coordination between Operations, Planning, Purchasing, Manufacturing Engineering, and the MDM CCO (Commercialization Change Order) Team to minimize operational disruptions and optimize inventory utilization during revision transitions. He/she is accountable for team performance, process standardization, escalation management, and continuous improvement across the regional CCO operations footprint.

**Responsibilities**

* Directly manage and develop a team of 8 analysts across multiple manufacturing plants
* Ensure all revision changeover processes are executed consistently and within defined SLAs across all assigned plants
* Standardize workflows, templates, and reporting across the regional team to drive operational excellence
* Monitor and manage workload distribution across analysts to ensure balanced coverage and timely execution
* Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-risk revision changeover issues that cannot be resolved at the analyst level
* Coordinate cross-plant dependencies and communicate regional impacts to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
* Analyst trends in changeover disruptions, scrap, rework, and inventory costs to drive data-informed decision-making
* Support the development and refinement of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for CCO operations
* Provide regular status updates and executive summaries to MDM Operations leadership on regional performance and risks
* Gather, scrub, manipulate data to generate average to complex reports and analysis related to Part and Supplier requirement
* Ensure predefined process is followed to ensure accuracy of information
* Oversee task tracking sheet for CCO revision updates, ensuring updates provided timely by all cross-functional teams
* Maintain knowledge of products and parts

* Intermediate MS Excel knowledge
* Intermediate MS PowerPoint knowledge
* Strong written and communication skills
* Experience in using ERP systems
* Intermediate knowledge and experience on Bill of Materials Management and Item Creation in ERP
* Knowledge and experience in using Power BI
* Demonstrated ability to manage remote/distributed teams across multiple sites
* 5-7 years of experience in operations, supply chain, or manufacturing environment

* Bachelor's Degree in Related Field (Business, Engineering, etc.) or Equivalent Work Experience

**Platform Engineer, Remote (EU) – International Client**

**Job role:** Platform Engineer.

**Minimum experience:** 5-7 years.

**Studies required:** Engineer.

**Language:** English (C1) **(Mandatory).**

**Location:** Remote (EU).

**DESCRIPTION:**

We are looking for an Azure / Databricks Platform Engineer to support and administer cloud, data, and DevOps platforms across Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure DevOps environments. The role is responsible for ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable platform operations, while maintaining governance, access controls, network connectivity, and deployment capabilities across the ecosystem.

The successful candidate will manage Azure infrastructure and networking services, administer Databricks platforms and security configurations, support Microsoft Fabric environments, and oversee Azure DevOps services including repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and service connections. You will work to maintain platform stability, compliance, and operational excellence while enabling efficient data and application delivery across the organization.

**Tasks:**

- Administer and maintain Azure platform services and cloud infrastructure.
- Configure and manage Azure networking components, including VNets, Subnets, Private Endpoints, and DNS services.
- Support Azure subscription governance, security controls, and platform compliance requirements.
- Manage Azure RBAC permissions and identity integrations.
- Administer Azure Web Apps, Storage Accounts, App Registrations, and Azure Data Factory services.
- Configure and maintain Databricks environments, including platform settings, security controls, and access management.
- Manage Databricks permissions, compute resources, and workspace configuration.
- Administer Unity Catalog and support data governance and access control requirements.
- Configure network integration and external data access within Databricks environments.
- Support Microsoft Fabric administration, including access management, workspace deployment, capacity management, and gateway configuration.
- Enable and maintain data integrations across Microsoft Fabric and related platforms.
- Administer Azure DevOps environments, including repositories, security settings, service connections, and agent pools.
- Build, maintain, and support CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
- Monitor platform operations and ensure reliability, security, and scalability across cloud and data services.
- Collaborate with infrastructure, engineering, analytics, and operations teams to support platform adoption and continuous improvement.

**Specific Expertise:**

- Strong experience administering Microsoft Azure environments and cloud services.
- Expertise in Azure networking, including VNets, Subnets, Private Endpoints, and DNS.
- Experience with Azure subscription governance, security, and operational management.
- Strong knowledge of Azure RBAC, identity integration, and access management.
- Hands-on experience with Azure Web Apps, Storage Accounts, App Registrations, and Azure Data Factory.
- Proven experience administering Databricks production environments.
- Strong knowledge of Databricks security, permissions, compute management, and platform configuration.
- Experience implementing and managing Unity Catalog.
- Knowledge of Databricks network integration and external data access configurations.
- Experience supporting and administering Microsoft Fabric environments.
- Expertise in Fabric access management, workspace deployment, capacity administration, and gateway configuration.
- Strong experience with Azure DevOps administration.
- Proven expertise in managing repositories, CI/CD pipelines, agent pools, service connections, and DevOps security.
- Strong understanding of cloud platform reliability, scalability, governance, and operational best practices.

**Nice to Have:**

- Experience working across integrated Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure DevOps ecosystems.
- Knowledge of enterprise data platform governance and security best practices.
- Experience supporting large-scale cloud and data platform deployments.
- Exposure to automation and infrastructure standardization initiatives.

**Language:**

- English (C1).

**Location:**

- Remote (EU).

**Rate:**

- 241-261€/day.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

**The opportunity** As a Security Engineer within the Security Technology Services (STS) group, become part of a global team responsible for the design, engineering, implementation and early life cycle support within our EY multi-cloud and on-premise environments. This role will work closely across teams and with Security Architects, Service Delivery, Security Operations, and Cyber Defense for the enablement of security solutions and services. You will also provide consulting services to other teams, and as a level four contact for operational issues.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engineer security solutions and services following all relevant EY standards and practices for On-Premise, Hybrid and Cloud-Based environments.
* Leads the design, implementation, testing of security solutions and services for a large or more complex project to its completion which includes production support and documentation.
* Takes accountability for the design, delivery and maintenance of new and existing security solutions or services, driving compliance with and contributing to the development of relevant standards.
* Apply modern standards/principles, global product-specific guidelines, security standards, design standards, to security solutions and services as appropriate.
* Improve existing security solutions and services in use by partnering with Security Architecture, STS Service Owner, and Security Operations. Drives automation and innovation across the security solutions supported.
* Work in a diverse, global environment and build strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically, and culturally dispersed organization.
* Flexible to work out of regular office hours to accommodate the team and organizational calls and meetings. Weekend or late-night work may occur during the project and early life cycle support phases.
* No direct supervision responsibilities though technical leadership required within assigned projects.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Advanced skills in planning, designing, and solving complex security solutions and services
* Advanced technical proficiency in designing and implementing at least one or more of the following security solutions within multi-cloud environments such Azure, AWS, GCP or similar technologies including:

* Anti-Malware tools

* Privilege Management

* Mobile Security

* Data Encryption

* Data Protection
* Communicate fluently in English, both written and verbal and able to communicate technical concepts effectively
* Excellent interpersonal communication and organizational skills and the ability to work within tight timeframes
* Rapidly learn new and emerging technologies with ability to rapidly define engineering standards

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Desire to work in a diverse, multi-cultural, global environment
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent work experience required
* 4+ years of Information Security experience
* 3+ years demonstrated ability in an engineering function
* Technical proficiency in Endpoint or Data security solutions on Linux, Mac and Windows OS Platforms
* Technical proficiency with writing custom, scripting tools (Python, Ansible, PowerShell, etc), interacting with API's and shell scripting
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Understanding of other technologies required to run a secure, enterprise level infrastructure that adhere to security best practices
* Excellent time management, organizational, and decision-making skills
* Ability to document processes, procedures, and security designs clearly and accurately for distribution to internal teams and customers
* Demonstrated experience in dealing with external vendors and suppliers in the security industry

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Technical experience in a large, complex, global IT environment
* Involved in large scale global IT deployments or application cloud migrations
* Experience with Microsoft suite of Security products

**What We Look For** A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition to learn and passion for delivering security solutions and services.

**What We Offer** As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

**If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.** **Make your mark.** **Apply now.**

About IonQ: IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security.

About IonQ :

IonQ , Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: Seattle, WA (preferred); open to College Park, MD or Remote
Travel: 10% domestic or international
Job ID: 1714

The Role:

We are seeking a high-caliber Staff Client Systems Engineer to own, integrate, and optimize our global endpoint ecosystem and employee lifecycle automation. In this role, you will be the principal designer of our core operating system configurations and "Gold Images" across a diverse enterprise environment (Mac, Windows, and Ubuntu Linux).

Beyond endpoint management, you will serve as the strategic technical bridge between IT and HR. You will architect, implement, and troubleshoot advanced onboarding, offboarding, and transfer workflows—specifically engineering the automated enterprise identity pipeline between Workday and Okta. This role is critical to scaling our global infrastructure, eliminating manual IT overhead, and ensuring a secure, flawless day-one experience for our workforce.

Responsibilities :

Enterprise Endpoint Architecture & Imaging

- Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade "Gold OS Images" and deployment configurations for macOS, Windows 10/11, and Ubuntu Linux.

- Architect zero touch provisioning workflows leveraging Autopilot and ADE.

- Partner closely with the IT Provisioning Team to optimize hardware staging workflows, ensuring images deploy flawlessly and efficiently to end-user machines.

- Own and optimize modern Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and MDM platforms (e.g., Jamf, Intune, Kandji) for zero-touch provisioning, automated patching, and security compliance enforcement.

HR & IT Lifecycle Automation (Workday ⇄ Okta)

- Architect and manage the end-to-end automated lifecycle pipeline using Workday and Okta Lifecycle Management.

- Design and implement intelligent, automated intake forms and workflows (via Jira Service Management, or Okta Workflows) for hiring managers to submit new-hire technical profiles.

- Build automated solutions for employee transfers, role changes, and terminations to ensure instant down-stream SaaS provisioning, precise access revocation, and tight security governance.

Tier-3 Escalation & Mentorship

- Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for complex identity, access management (IAM), and automated provisioning failures.

- Proactively troubleshoot and resolve deep architectural mismatches between Workday data attributes and Okta downstream applications.

- Establish and maintain robust troubleshooting runbooks and technical documentation, empowering Helpdesk and Systems Administrators to independently resolve lifecycle and imaging issues.

- Provide continuous technical mentorship to junior administrators, helpdesk technicians, and contractor teams to elevate the organization's overall technical capability and operational self-sufficiency.

Requirements:

- Experience: 6+ years of experience in Client Systems Engineering, Endpoint Architecture, or IT Infrastructure Automation.

- Workday & Okta Integration: Proven track record of configuring and maintaining Workday-driven identity provisioning within Okta. Must understand Workday attribute mapping, lifecycle states, and troubleshooting Okta expression language/workflows.

- Multi-OS Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of configuring, securing, and imaging Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu Linux at enterprise scale.

- Modern Provisioning: Deep familiarity with modern, zero-touch deployment frameworks such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager (ABM).

- Experience with Configuration Management tools: Ansible, Chef, Puppet.

- Automation & Form Building: Hands-on experience building dynamic service catalogs, custom forms, and conditional routing workflows for business stakeholders.

- Scripting Capabilities: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, Python) to automate API integrations, custom packaging, and OS configurations.

- Experience in engaging with multiple hardware vendors and VARs.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Advanced certifications: Okta Certified Consultant/Developer , Jamf Certified Admin , or Workday Extend/Integration certification .

- Experience with API integration tools (Postman, Workato, or Okta Workflows).

The approximate base salary range for this position is $126,887- $166,127. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. jobs.description:
The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining and executing enterprise endpoint, security, and identity architecture across Windows, macOS, and mobile device environments.

The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining and executing enterprise endpoint, security, and identity architecture across Windows, macOS, and mobile device environments. The position leads the modernization of traditional endpoint management toward cloud-first Modern Management using Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows Autopilot, Jamf Pro, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Management.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Architecture & Modernization

- Own and maintain the enterprise EUC and endpoint management roadmap across Windows and macOS.

- Architect Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Jamf Pro environments.

- Lead SCCM-to-Intune modernization and co-management initiatives.

- Design modern provisioning strategies using Windows Autopilot and Apple Automated Device Enrollment.

- Establish enterprise endpoint architecture, governance, standards, and operational procedures.

macOS & Jamf Management

- Architect and manage enterprise Jamf Pro capabilities.

- Design macOS enrollment, provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management strategies.

- Manage configuration profiles, policies, application deployment, patching, compliance, and inventory.

- Implement FileVault encryption, macOS security controls, and configuration standards.

- Develop macOS upgrade and lifecycle strategies.

- Integrate Jamf with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Conditional Access, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Cross-Platform Endpoint Management

- Establish consistent endpoint management standards across Windows and macOS.

- Develop enterprise strategies for provisioning, application deployment, patching, compliance, security, and device lifecycle management.

- Ensure Windows and macOS platforms meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.

Windows Lifecycle Management

- Lead large-scale Windows migration and modernization projects.

- Design OS deployment, in-place upgrade, and device replacement strategies.

- Develop deployment rings, pilot programs, and risk mitigation plans.

- Create automated deployment and upgrade frameworks capable of supporting tens of thousands of endpoints.

Engineering & Automation

- Develop automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, .NET, SQL, REST APIs, and other scripting technologies.

- Automate endpoint provisioning, application deployment, security remediation, patching, and compliance processes.

- Develop custom inventory, compliance, reporting, and endpoint management solutions.

- Integrate endpoint management platforms with identity and security technologies.

Endpoint Security

- Architect Microsoft Defender for Endpoint across Windows and macOS.

- Develop security baselines, vulnerability remediation processes, and endpoint detection and response capabilities.

- Implement Attack Surface Reduction, endpoint compliance, disk encryption, and device security controls.

- Partner with Cybersecurity and SOC teams to improve endpoint detection, response, and threat monitoring.

- Support Zero Trust initiatives through device compliance, device health, Conditional Access, and identity-driven security controls.

Identity & Privileged Access

- Integrate endpoints with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, PAM, and identity governance technologies.

- Architect CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager and Microsoft Endpoint Privilege Management solutions.

- Develop least-privilege strategies for Windows and macOS.

- Govern local administrator rights and application elevation.

- Partner with IAM teams to integrate endpoint management with enterprise identity and access management architecture.

Security Analytics

- Develop KQL queries for Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics, and Advanced Hunting.

- Build security and compliance dashboards using PowerBI and SQL.

- Develop threat-hunting queries and correlate endpoint telemetry with identity, vulnerability, and configuration data.

- Automate security reporting and operational workflows.

Technical Leadership

- Serve as the senior technical escalation point for Endpoint Engineering.

- Act as the architectural authority for Windows, macOS, Intune, SCCM, Jamf, endpoint security, and endpoint/identity integration.

- Mentor endpoint engineers and administrators.

- Lead architecture reviews and enterprise technology decisions.

- Develop standards, documentation, reference architectures, and operational procedures.

- Drive collaboration across Endpoint Engineering, Cybersecurity, IAM, Infrastructure, and Application teams.

Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate has extensive experience architecting and managing large-scale enterprise endpoint environments across Windows and macOS. They should possess deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Jamf Pro, Windows Autopilot, Apple Automated Device Enrollment, Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS, Android, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Entra ID, Conditional Access, CyberArk EPM, PowerShell, shell scripting, KQL, endpoint security, and Zero Trust architecture.

The candidate should have demonstrated experience leading enterprise endpoint transformation initiatives and be capable of bridging Endpoint Engineering, Cybersecurity, and IAM while providing senior-level architecture and technical leadership.

In short, this is a Senior EUC / Endpoint Security & Identity Architect responsible for the architecture, modernization, security, and lifecycle management of the organization's complete Windows, macOS, and mobile device endpoint ecosystem, with Intune, SCCM, and Jamf serving as the core endpoint management platforms.

jobs.summary: The Basics: Tanium's Product Management team is actively seeking a Director, Product Management to lead Policy and Configuration Management for the Endpoint Management portfolio . This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning the...
jobs.description:
The Basics:

Tanium's Product Management team is actively seeking a Director, Product Management to lead Policy and Configuration Management for the Endpoint Management portfolio . This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning the strategy, roadmap, and execution of how Tanium defines, applies, and proves configuration state across the enterprise — giving IT and Security teams a single way to set policy once and enforce it consistently across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints, regardless of whether those endpoints are on-premises, remote, or in the cloud.

The successful candidate will own the product strategy behind Tanium's centralized policy engine: application allow/deny control, full-disk encryption, device and removable media control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template (Group Policy-style) policy. This includes the migration tooling that lets customers import existing Group Policy backups and industry hardening standards — such as CIS Build Kits and vendor security baselines — directly into managed policy. You will also shape the next generation of policy types that supersede legacy mechanisms as customers modernize off traditional, on-premises group policy infrastructure.

You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to set vision, drive roadmap, ship capabilities customers trust for compliance and audit, and turn consistent configuration state into measurable risk reduction for customers.

A successful candidate is a strong communicator and influencer who can operate fluently across executive stakeholder conversations, deep technical architecture discussions, and customer-facing storytelling. Must have a successful track record of shipping enterprise configuration management, compliance, or policy products at scale.

What you'll do

- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Tanium's endpoint policy and configuration management capabilities, end to end from ideation to launch.

- Drive the roadmap for Windows policy and configuration management — application control (allow/deny rules), full-disk encryption, device and removable storage control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template policy — ensuring parity with and differentiation from traditional Group Policy infrastructure.

- Expand Linux configuration management capabilities (e.g., host firewall management and hardening controls), building out coverage on top of an established Windows foundation.

- Own the strategy for legacy migration and baseline import tooling — Group Policy backup import and industry hardening standard support (CIS Build Kits, vendor security baselines) that automatically convert a downloaded benchmark file into a ready-to-enforce compliance policy, complete with conflict detection across overlapping settings and automatic content-set mapping — and for next-generation policy types that supersede legacy equivalents as customers modernize.

- Define and evolve policy enforcement state and compliance reporting (applied, partially applied, superseded, not applied) so customers can prove configuration compliance and audit posture at any time.

- Partner with incident response, reporting, and guidance capabilities across the platform to turn security findings into durable preventive policy and to surface actionable configuration drift and remediation guidance to operators.

- Document customer use cases, product requirements, and business justifications for new policy and configuration investments; prioritize ruthlessly based on customer risk reduction, compliance mandates, and platform leverage.

- Partner with Product Marketing and Sales to develop go-to-market motions, enablement, and messaging ; support launches, analyst engagements, and customer briefings.

- Cultivate strategic customer relationships to validate direction, surface gaps, and turn lighthouse deployments into reference architectures.

- Establish and track KPIs — policy adoption, time-to-compliance, configuration drift and remediation rates, and platform pull-through — and use them to drive continuous improvement.

- Leverage emerging trends in agentic AI and autonomous IT to shape the roadmap for self-healing, continuously enforced endpoint configuration.

Requirements

Education

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

- Masters in Computer Science or MBA preferred.

Experience

- 8+ years of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least 5 years in product management supporting a SaaS or enterprise platform.

- Required: hands-on experience with Windows policy and configuration management — Group Policy, ADMX administrative templates, security baselines, full-disk encryption, application control, or comparable endpoint configuration tooling.

- Strong bonus: in-depth experience with Linux configuration management — configuration/hardening frameworks, host firewall management, or compliance baselines for Linux systems.

- Demonstrated success owning and shipping policy, compliance, or configuration management products at enterprise scale.

- Deep familiarity with endpoint management and IT operations — including the customer workflows that span IT and Security teams.

- Strong fluency with compliance frameworks and industry baselines (e.g., CIS benchmarks, vendor security baselines) and how they translate into enforceable policy.

- Experience working with executive stakeholders to align on vision, secure investment, and unblock execution.

- Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, marketing, and sales without direct authority.

Other

- Align with the Tanium values: we win as a team, we do the right thing, and we are unstoppable .

- Intuition to identify high-leverage configuration and compliance gaps that align with Tanium's platform and present opportunities for rapid growth.

- Willingness to take on firmly-entrenched, legacy configuration management incumbents with creative approaches to technology and a tenacious pursuit to build and grow a product's customer base.

- Ability to establish and nurture strong customer champions who can serve as advocates and an informal advisory board.

- Strong written communication, verbal communication, and executive presentation skills.

- Adept at understanding and navigating complex organizations in order to inspire and influence internal and external stakeholders.

- Grit; ability to deal with and overcome challenges, and to thrive in ambiguity.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What you’ll get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $214,000 to $328,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com . For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - https://www.eeoc.gov/poster .

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey runs on a fleet of Macs and Windows devices, and every one of them is the front door to how each Harvey employee does their work. We're seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to own client engineering end to end - Jamf, Intune, Autopilot, Okta device trust, and more, and the automation that ties them together. This is the person who decides how a laptop gets built, secured, patched, recovered, and retired, and who makes those decisions hold up as we scale across offices globally.

The ideal candidate has run a production device management environment at scale and can move between writing the deployment tooling, debugging a broken enrollment, and pushing for improvements to policy, process, and systems along the way.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the endpoint platform. Jamf Pro for macOS, Intune and Autopilot for Windows, and the mobile fleet alongside them. You set configuration standards, patching cadence, and compliance baselines in partnership with Security, and you're accountable for the fleet actually meeting them.

- Engineer the device lifecycle. Zero-touch provisioning through Apple Business Manager and Autopilot, automated onboarding and offboarding, hardware refreshes, DLP, and forensics. Where the lifecycle still depends on someone remembering to do something, replace that with code.

- Build the automation the fleet runs on. Most of this role's leverage comes from tooling - Python and scripts against Jamf, Intune, and Okta APIs, event-driven workflows, and self-service that lets employees fix their own problems.

- Partner with Security on endpoint posture. Work directly with Security on endpoint policies, EDR coverage, device trust and Okta FastPass, disk encryption and key escrow, browser management, and more.

- Be the final escalation for endpoint issues. IT Operations handles tier 1 and 2 globally; the problems that reach you are the strange ones. You'll fix them, and then fix the class of problem so the next person doesn't file the ticket.

- Support a global, in-person-heavy company. Harvey has offices across the US, EMEA, and APAC. You'll build for time zones you aren't in, and document and train the team well enough that someone in each location can resolve issues independently.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Minimum 5 years in endpoint, client, or IT systems engineering, including direct ownership of a macOS MDM environment at 1000+ devices.

- Deep hands-on Jamf experience, plus real Windows management experience via Intune, Autopilot, and Entra.

- Strong scripting and automation ability in Python, Bash, or Swift, with a track record of building tooling against vendor APIs rather than clicking through admin consoles.

- Working fluency with an IdP, Okta preferred, covering SSO, MFA, device trust, and how identity and endpoint policy interact.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with non-technical teams.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and global environment.

BONUS POINTS:

- Experience running endpoint security tooling in a production environment - CrowdStrike or equivalent EDR, managed Chrome Enterprise, DLP.

- Endpoint work inside a compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

COMPENSATION

$153,000 - $210,500 USD

jobs.description:
About Gallatin

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

About The Role

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to help build and scale the systems Gallatin employees rely on every day.

As the second dedicated IT hire, you will work across endpoint engineering, identity and access management, SaaS administration, security and compliance, office infrastructure, automation, and employee support. You will own systems end to end and help define how IT operates as Gallatin grows.

This is a broad systems role with a strong endpoint focus. You should be able to operate across macOS, Windows, mobile, identity, and cloud applications, with hands-on experience in Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, Google Workspace, and Okta. Experience managing Windows devices and access controls in Microsoft 365 GCC High is especially important.

The level is flexible. We care more about technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to build reliable systems than a specific title or number of years.

What You'll Do

Build and Own Endpoint Management

Own the lifecycle of Gallatin’s macOS, Windows, and mobile environments, from enrollment through deprovisioning. Build and maintain Jamf Pro policies, profiles, packages, scripts, smart groups, compliance controls, and Self Service workflows. Implement and operate Windows device management through Microsoft Intune in GCC High. Design Google Workspace mobile application management controls for employee-owned devices. Automate provisioning, application deployment, patching, security baselines, inventory, and compliance reporting.

Scale Identity and Enterprise Systems

Own identity lifecycle workflows across Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 GCC High, Slack, and other business-critical platforms. Automate onboarding, role changes, access reviews, and offboarding using APIs, scripts, and workflow tools. Design access controls around least privilege, device trust, role-based access, and data sensitivity. Administer and integrate Gallatin’s core productivity, collaboration, engineering, and business applications. Establish guardrails for enterprise AI tools and AI-enabled SaaS applications, including authentication, provisioning, data handling, retention, integrations, and audit logging. Partner with Security and Engineering to protect sensitive company and government data while enabling employees to use approved AI tools productively. Replace brittle manual processes with systems that are repeatable, observable, and difficult to misuse.

Strengthen and Operate the Environment

Translate CMMC, NIST 800-171, and other requirements into technical controls that work in practice. Build reliable device compliance, access enforcement, evidence collection, and audit-readiness workflows. Troubleshoot complex issues across endpoints, identity, SaaS applications, networking, authentication, and operating systems. Provide direct employee support while eliminating recurring failure modes through engineering and automation. Create clear documentation, runbooks, standards, and employee-facing guidance. Take ownership of unfamiliar problems and drive them through resolution.

What We’re Looking For

Experience as an IT Systems Engineer, Endpoint Engineer, Systems Administrator, or in a similarly broad technical role. Strong hands-on Okta administration, including SSO, MFA, application integrations, lifecycle management, and access policies. Strong hands-on management of macOS, Windows, and mobile devices using Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, and Google Workspace. Experience operating Microsoft 365 and Intune in GCC High or another regulated Microsoft cloud environment. Ability to independently design, implement, operate, and improve production IT systems. Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, networks, identity platforms, and cloud applications. Automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, APIs, or workflow platforms. Understanding of identity lifecycle management, device trust, least privilege, conditional access, and role-based access. Strong communication, documentation, and judgment in fast-moving environments. Comfort operating in a small team where ownership is broad and outcomes matter more than organizational boundaries.

Bonus Points

Endpoint privilege management and application control. Enterprise browser management, secure web gateways, or SaaS security posture management. macOS Platform SSO or Windows Hello for Business. PKI, device certificates, and certificate lifecycle management. Configuration-as-code or infrastructure-as-code for corporate IT systems.

Mission and Identity

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

Why Gallatin?

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.

Compensation: Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary.

We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.

Note: Due to the nature of certain government contracts held by this organization, U.S. citizenship is a requirement for all positions at Gallatin. Proof of citizenship will be required prior to employment if selected.

jobs.description:
Omni Corporate Offices

Omni Hotels and Resorts creates genuine, authentic guest experiences at over 50 distinctive luxury hotels and resorts in leading business gateways and leisure destinations across North America. Omni Hotels is known for its exemplary culture, authenticity to the markets in which we operate, innovation and exceptional service. Our commitment to career development has created tenure and loyalty that enables us to perpetuate our family atmosphere.

Overview

The ITSM Operations Administrator reports to the Sr Manager, IT Service Desk. This role administers, deploys, secures, maintains, and continuously optimizes the organization’s enterprise endpoint management environment, with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID.

This role manages the lifecycle of corporate Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices, including enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, operating system updates, vulnerability remediation, and device retirement.

The Endpoint Management Administrator partners closely with IT Support Services, Infrastructure, Information Security, Field Technology, and application owners to provide a secure, standardized, and reliable endpoint experience across corporate and property environments.

Key Responsibilities

Administer and maintain the Microsoft Intune environment
Create, test, deploy, and maintain Intune configuration profiles and policies
Manage Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices through Microsoft Intune
Maintain device enrollment profiles, enrollment restrictions, and device configuration standards
Monitor enrollment failures, device health, compliance status, and policy deployment results
Troubleshoot Intune synchronization, enrollment, configuration, and policy issues
Maintain appropriate role-based access and administrative permissions within the endpoint management environment
Review the environment regularly for opportunities to improve reliability, standardization, security, and automation
Manage Autopilot hardware hashes, device records, group tags, and deployment profiles
Configure and maintain Enrollment Status Page settings
Support standardized provisioning processes for laptops, desktops, and all-in-one devices
Troubleshoot Windows Out-of-Box Experience and Autopilot deployment failures
Maintain established device naming and provisioning standards
Support device wipe, reset, reimage, replacement, and reassignment processes
Package, test, deploy, update, and maintain applications through Microsoft Intune
Create and maintain Win32 application packages
Coordinate pilot and phased application deployments before broad production rollout
Publish approved applications to Company Portal when appropriate
Maintain application versions and retire outdated packages
Work with business and technical application owners to validate application functionality prior to production deployment
Troubleshoot application installation and deployment failures
Support the complete endpoint lifecycle from initial provisioning through retirement
Perform new device provisioning, enrollment, replacement, reassignment, wipe/reset, reimaging, retirement, and decommissioning.

Follow established change management requirements for production endpoint changes
