jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, LAUNCH

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained launch cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Must be willing to work extended hours, weekends, and night shifts as launch manifest dictates.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Willing to travel (up to 20%) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs. unassisted

- Ability to work at heights.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

IT Systems Administrator: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

jobs.description:
ABOUT YOU
Are you the go-to problem solver when technology doesn’t cooperate? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same? Do you enjoy troubleshooting issues, optimizing systems, and creating a seamless experience for end users? If the answer is “Yes!” then we have an exciting opportunity for you. We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.

We are seeking a proactive and service-oriented Desktop Administrator to support and enhance our Windows-based and cloud-connected environment. In this role, you will be responsible for managing end-user devices, supporting identity and access through Azure Active Directory, and ensuring devices remain secure and compliant using tools like Microsoft Intune.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU
We are dedicated to the well-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.

Industry-leading performance-based bonus program
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
Traditional and Roth 401k
Tuition reimbursement for associates
Scholarship for associates’ children up to $28,000 per child
1-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel
1-week paid volunteer leave each year
100% charitable match
Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
100% paid 12-week maternity leave

At ARCO, our first core value is to treat people fairly and do the right thing. We are committed to building and sustaining a culture that supports diversity and inclusion. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.
From recruiting, training, and hiring practices to selecting our subcontractors, we understand that diversity of all those involved in the construction process enhances our ability to deliver the best solutions to our customers. We hire the best and the brightest from across the country - constructing a team of experts in architecture, design, engineering, project management, and business services.
A DAY IN THE LIFE
Endpoint Management & Administration

Serve as primary administrator of Microsoft Intune across a diverse device fleet including Windows 11 (physical and virtual), macOS, iOS, and Android
Manage device configuration policies, compliance baselines, and endpoint protection across both commercial and GCC High (secured) environments
Oversee application deployment, driver updates, and patching through Intune and Windows Update for Business
Maintain device provisioning policies and procedures via Microsoft Autopilot, supporting the full device lifecycle from provisioning through retirement

Identity & Policy Management

Manage device and group objects within Microsoft Entra ID
Administer Group Policy for on-premises environments while participating in the ongoing transition to cloud-native Intune policies for cloud-joined endpoints

Third-Party Platform Administration

Manage PatchMyPC for third-party application update deployment and quality assurance
Administer Apple Business Manager to streamline iOS device provisioning in the corporate environment
Maintain PrinterLogic for cloud-based printer driver deployment and configuration management; collaborate with the Support team and vendors on escalated printer and copier issues

Collaboration & Customer Experience

Act as the escalation point for the wider IT Support team on complex endpoint issues, providing timely communication around troubleshooting steps, workarounds, and ongoing issue status

Reporting & Documentation

Produce regular reporting on device compliance, patching metrics, end user experience, and inventory details using Microsoft Excel and Power BI
Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation for systems, processes, and troubleshooting procedures

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

2-5+ years of experience in endpoint administration and desktop support, with strong hands-on expertise in enterprise Windows 11 environments (2000+ devices)
Demonstrated experience administering Microsoft Intune, including device configuration, compliance policies, application deployment, and security baselines; Proficiency managing identities, devices, and groups within Microsoft Entra ID
Experience with Microsoft PowerShell to support remediations & application deployment for endpoints
Experience managing mobile endpoints across iOS and Android platforms, as well as supporting macOS devices
Working knowledge of Group Policy and traditional Active Directory environments; Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Exchange Online, Teams, and OneDrive
Understanding of core networking fundamentals including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and VPN; Experience supporting and troubleshooting printer and copier environments
Proven ability to act as a technical escalation point for end-user support teams, with strong troubleshooting and communication skills
Ability to maintain clear documentation and effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences

MAKE YOUR MOVE
We are proud to be one of the fastest-growing, privately-owned companies in America, celebrating over 30 years of experience as design-build experts. We have completed over 6,550 design-build projects nationwide. We ranked #6 on ENR’s Design-Build Firms list and #29 on ENR's Top 400 Contractors list of 2025. Most importantly, our clients like us, trust us and want to do business with us. We are looking for people with the same enthusiasm, passion, and respect for the hard work that brought us to where we are today. Are you a person that can make a difference at ARCO? If the answer is, “Yes!” we look forward to meeting you.

jobs.description:
Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced M365 Security and Compliance Administrator to join our Information Technology team. This role requires a seasoned professional who can strategically manage and enhance the security and compliance posture of the M365 environment within a GCC (Government Community Cloud) tenant, particularly in a federal agency context. This senior engineering role sits at the center of the organization’s device, identity, and M365 security ecosystem. The engineer is responsible for protecting enterprise Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS endpoints; ensuring compliant, reliable access to M365 services, and driving rapid engineering responses to vulnerabilities, outages, and operational risks. The successful candidate will apply with deep technical expertise, cross-platform engineering capability, and high operational security judgment.

Role Summary: Responsible for securing and maintaining compliance of the Microsoft 365 (M365) ecosystem and enterprise endpoints. Leads security governance, implements and enforces controls across M365, email, identity, devices, and telemetry, and provides incident response and audit/ATO support to ensure alignment with federal and organizational security requirements.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic security oversight & governance

Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing management of M365 security policies, standards, and technical guardrails aligned to federal requirements and organizational controls.

Own governance for data protection capabilities including document classification, labeling, retention, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) using Microsoft Purview.

Email security & compliance management (Exchange Online)

Define and enforce email security policies such as encryption, sensitivity labeling, and secure mail flow to reduce unauthorized disclosure.

Implement and maintain email encryption solutions (S/MIME and/or Microsoft Information Protection) to protect confidentiality of email communications.

Administer and monitor anti-spam, anti-phishing, and anti-malware protections to defend against evolving threats.

Identity, access, and conditional access (Entra ID)

Engineer and validate device-compliance–based Conditional Access policies across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

Investigate and remediate Conditional Access failures, identity anomalies, and external/guest access issues, including M365 B2B trust and secure partner collaboration requirements.

Endpoint & device security engineering (Intune)

Design, test, and deploy Intune configuration and compliance policies for Windows, macOS, and iOS/iPadOS, including Enrollment Status Pages (ESPs) and OOBE workflows.

Develop remediation scripts (PowerShell/platform scripts/configuration profiles) to close compliance gaps and enforce security baselines.

Coordinate enterprise rollout of urgent vulnerability mitigations and validated vendor fixes; support vulnerability reviews and baseline rebuilds.

Risk management & compliance assurance (ATO / controls)

Establish and operate a risk management approach to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the M365 ecosystem.

Support ATO/control assessment activities by drafting implementation statements, collecting artifacts, and providing evidence aligned to audit/logging requirements.

Security monitoring, SIEM, and telemetry engineering (Defender / Sentinel)

Lead integration and operational management of Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel for threat detection, alerting, and response across M365.

Build and maintain SIEM integrations/connectors (e.g., M365, collaboration and identity systems) and develop ingestion pipelines (e.g., Azure Function Apps) for third-party logs.

Tune audit retention, analytic rules, and alert logic to improve signal quality and investigation readiness.

Incident response & operational support / collaboration

Provide Tier 3 troubleshooting for device compliance failures, identity/access incidents, telemetry gaps, and OS/app protection issues.

Partner with cross-functional teams to align security solutions with business objectives, deliver technical leadership, and support enterprise syncs and operational reviews.

Continuous improvement & innovation

Stay current on M365 security/compliance updates, industry trends, and emerging capabilities; drive improvements to security posture and operational efficiency (including use of GCC Copilot where appropriate).

Platform Scope / Tooling Microsoft 365 (GCC), Microsoft Purview (DLP/labels/classification/retention), Exchange Online, Entra ID & Conditional Access, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure (Function Apps / Log Analytics), plus integrations with collaboration/IT systems (e.g., ticketing and SaaS log sources).

“Day in the Life"

Morning

Review Sentinel incidents, Defender telemetry gaps, and compliance drift.

Respond to overnight CAP failures, Slack EMM issues, or OS update regressions.

Join device/enterprise standups.

Midday

Build/test remediation scripts (CVE fixes, NTLM disablement, compliance corrections).

Deploy or test Intune configuration profiles, ESP changes, or app protection updates.

Troubleshoot support cases with Microsoft (Purview DSPM, Copilot logs, Okta connector).

Afternoon

Conduct cross-team investigations (external-user access anomalies, Teams meeting forensics).

Validate CAP behaviors across platforms using test devices.

Work on ATO evidence packages and documentation.

End of Day

Update Jira tasks, Confluence documentation, and CR submissions.

Send status updates on active investigations, mitigations, and test results.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

Expert-level Intune engineering across Windows/macOS/iOS/iPadOS.

Advanced PowerShell for remediation, automation, and OS image manipulation.

Deep experience with Microsoft Defender (XDR, Endpoint, Cloud Apps).

Hands-on with Sentinel SIEM, Function Apps, and cross-platform telemetry pipelines.

Strong understanding of CAP architecture and identity risk enforcement.

Experience with ATO control evidence, compliance mapping, and audit support.

Soft Skills

Growth mindset and willingness to learn emerging security domains.

Strong cross-team collaboration (Cyber, Ops, EA, ICAM, Comms).

Excellent communication—clear summaries, user-impact translation, and documentation.

High reliability, ownership, and situational awareness during high-severity events.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in federal security, high-compliance, or high‑assurance environments.

Experience with Jamf, Okta connectors, Copilot audit logging, Graph API operations.

Experience with mSCP baseline engineering and macOS security hardening.

Prior involvement in enterprise-wide Conditional Access enforcement.

jobs.description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

A Keyrus é um grupo internacional com **2.800 consultores** e especialistas em **28 países** , construído sobre uma convicção: **a IA não transforma empresas. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.**
Há mais de 30 anos, construímos as bases de dados que tornam os sistemas inteligentes possíveis, projetando o Sistema Operacional da Empresa Inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada ao núcleo dos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável: **operacionalizamos a inteligência.**

A IA não substitui os seres humanos. Ela nos reposiciona em um lugar que nenhum sistema pode alcançar: compreender, decidir, criar e inovar.
Na Keyrus, você não desenvolverá apenas habilidades; desenvolverá discernimento. Sua expertise se fortalece a cada sistema que você projeta, a cada desafio de negócio que ajuda a resolver e a cada implementação que evolui a partir dos aprendizados anteriores.

Com o tempo, você se tornará um dos profissionais mais raros da era da inteligência: alguém capaz de conectar dados, IA e tomada de decisão humana em escala, entre diferentes setores, mercados e geografias.
Esta não é apenas uma posição. É uma disciplina que você domina e uma história que ajuda a escrever para se tornar um **Arquiteto da Inteligência da Keyrus.**

A tecnologia amplia capacidades. A cultura da Keyrus diferencia. A excelência na execução conecta ambas.

**O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ ARQUITETAR**

Esta posição combina visão arquitetural, profundidade técnica e atuação consultiva. Buscamos profissionais capazes de transformar desafios complexos em soluções de dados escaláveis, modernas e orientadas a resultados.

**QUEM VOCÊ É**

Você é um profissional experiente que combina conhecimento técnico com visão estratégica de negócio.

Você entende que dados são a base para decisões mais inteligentes e para a transformação das organizações.

Você consegue navegar com naturalidade entre discussões arquiteturais, implementação técnica e relacionamento com stakeholders.

Você gosta de estruturar ambientes complexos, criar padrões e impulsionar a evolução tecnológica.

Você equilibra pragmatismo e inovação, priorizando soluções que geram impacto real.

Você compartilha conhecimento e contribui para o crescimento técnico das equipes ao seu redor.

Você possui perfil consultivo, analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

**O QUE VOCÊ TRAZ**

Estamos em busca de um(a) **Project Manager ou Scrum Master Sênior** , com sólida experiência em metodologias ágeis e **conhecimento técnico em MDM (Master Data Management)**.

A pessoa profissional será responsável por atuar junto aos times, facilitando a aplicação das práticas ágeis, promovendo melhoria contínua e garantindo uma boa interação entre equipe, stakeholders e demais áreas envolvidas nos projetos.

Além da atuação em Agile/Scrum, é importante possuir **conhecimento técnico em MDM**, sendo capaz de compreender, questionar e discutir temas relacionados à tecnologia e às soluções de gestão de dados mestres.

***Experiência e Qualificações***

* Atuar como **Scrum Master ou Project Manager**, de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;

* Conduzir e acompanhar cerimônias ágeis, como **Daily, Planning, Review e Retrospective**;

* Facilitar a comunicação e o relacionamento entre o time, stakeholders e demais áreas;

* Minimizar interferências externas e criar condições para que a equipe tenha foco e produtividade;

* Atuar como **mentor(a) do framework Scrum**, garantindo a aplicação adequada das práticas e princípios ágeis;

* Promover uma cultura de **colaboração, melhoria contínua e autonomia**;

* Identificar impedimentos e atuar na sua remoção, apoiando o time na resolução de obstáculos;

* Trabalhar junto à equipe na evolução dos processos e práticas de trabalho;

* Apoiar a utilização e análise de **métricas ágeis**, como Velocity, Lead Time e indicadores de produtividade;

* Participar de discussões relacionadas a **MDM**, contribuindo tecnicamente para decisões e direcionamentos do projeto;

* Atuar como agente de mudança, apoiando a evolução dos processos e da maturidade ágil da equipe.

***Requisitos:***

* Experiência sólida como **Scrum Master, Project Manager ou em posições similares**;

* Conhecimento de **metodologias e práticas Agile**;

* Experiência com **Scrum e cerimônias ágeis**;

* Conhecimento em ferramentas como **Jira e Azure DevOps**;

* Experiência com gestão e acompanhamento de projetos;

* Capacidade de atuação e comunicação com diferentes níveis de stakeholders;

* **Conhecimento técnico em MDM (Master Data Management)**, com capacidade de discutir, questionar e avaliar temas relacionados à tecnologia;

* Perfil analítico, comunicativo, colaborativo e orientado à melhoria contínua.

###### ***Diferenciais:***

* Experiência em projetos de **Data / MDM**;

* Conhecimento de métricas e indicadores ágeis;

* Experiência em ambientes de transformação digital e dados;

* Certificações Agile/Scrum ou gestão de projetos.

**O QUE FARÁ VOCÊ TER SUCESSO**

Excelente capacidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Facilidade para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções práticas e escaláveis.

Capacidade de influenciar decisões e construir relacionamentos de confiança com stakeholders.

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Foco na geração de valor e resultados para clientes e negócios.

Colaboração, compartilhamento de conhecimento e melhoria contínua como parte da sua forma de trabalhar.

**NOSSOS VALORES**

***Inteligência Coletiva***

A colaboração entre diferentes especialidades, funções e geografias nos permite combinar conhecimento e entregar respostas mais completas para os desafios dos nossos clientes.

***Confiabilidade***

A capacidade de entregar projetos complexos com rigor, qualidade e consistência é um dos pilares da nossa relação com clientes e parceiros.

***Pragmatismo***

Priorizamos impacto concreto e valor mensurável acima de discursos tecnológicos abstratos.

***Espírito Empreendedor***

Curiosidade, energia, autonomia e iniciativa são a base da nossa cultura e impulsionam a inovação contínua.

**ABOUT KEYRUS**

Na Keyrus, ajudamos as organizações a evoluir da IA experimental para a IA industrializada, de agentes isolados para sistemas orquestrados e de insights para execução.

Essa é a disciplina que chamamos de Architect of Intelligence: desenhar o sistema operacional da empresa inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada aos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável.

Impulsionados pelo nosso modelo proprietário Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), estruturamos fundações de inteligência, governança centrada no ser humano e direcionamento de performance para criar ambientes inteligentes onde a tecnologia amplia as capacidades humanas.

Com mais de 30 anos de experiência e 2.800 colaboradores distribuídos em 28 países, ajudamos organizações a ir além da transformação, construindo empresas adaptáveis, resilientes e em constante evolução.

A IA não transforma negócios. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.

Vem fazer parte do Time Keyrus!

jobs.description:
**Job Summary** The End-Point Lead/Architect owns the strategy, architecture, and team leadership for endpoint management across the Mosaic Infrastructure Managed Services engagement, supporting roughly 11,000 endpoints across the United States, Canada, Brazil, Peru, and Paraguay. This role combines deep technical expertise in Microsoft SCCM (Configuration Manager/MECM) and Microsoft Intune with people leadership of the End-Point Engineer Sr./Jr. team, and is a key driver of the account's ongoing migration from traditional, on-premises endpoint management toward modern, cloud-first management.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end architecture and roadmap for endpoint management across SCCM (Configuration Manager/MECM) and Microsoft Intune, including the co-management strategy between the two platforms.
* Lead the Endpoint Engineer Sr./Jr. team, assigning work, setting technical direction, and reviewing complex endpoint engineering deliverables.
* Design and govern device configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines in Intune, aligned to client security requirements.
* Drive the migration of managed endpoints from traditional SCCM-based management to modern, cloud-first Intune management, including Windows Autopilot deployment strategy.
* Own OS deployment (OSD), imaging, application packaging, and patch management standards across the managed endpoint estate.
* Serve as the primary escalation point and subject matter expert for complex endpoint issues that exceed Tier 2/3 support.
* Partner with the Security and NOC teams to ensure endpoint compliance policies, patching cadence, and vulnerability remediation are met.
* Coordinate mobile device management (MDM) and mobile application management (MAM) policy design, in line with the client's defined mobile device scope and exclusions.
* Maintain accurate documentation of the endpoint architecture, standards, and configuration baselines.
* Support hardware refresh and large-scale endpoint transition/migration programs, including planning and execution oversight.
* Mentor and develop Endpoint Engineer Sr./Jr. staff on SCCM/Intune administration and modern endpoint management practices.
* Report on endpoint compliance, deployment health, and project status to the Infrastructure Manager and client stakeholders.

**Skills And Experience** **What You'll Bring**

* 5 years of experience in Endpoint Management, End-User Computing, or Endpoint Engineering, including 2 years in a Lead or Architect role.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SCCM / Configuration Manager (MECM), including OS deployment, application packaging, software distribution, and patch management.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, including configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, and Windows Autopilot.
* Experience with SCCM and Intune co-management, including strategies to modernize and transition endpoint environments.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including hybrid join and Conditional Access concepts.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise endpoint solutions and contributing to technology strategy and roadmaps.
* Experience leading, mentoring, or providing technical direction to engineering teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Microsoft certification in Endpoint Management, such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate.
* Experience supporting large, multi-country enterprise environments.
* Experience with macOS, iOS, or Android device management.
* Experience working in a managed services or outsourced IT environment.
* Bilingual English/Spanish or English/Portuguese.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience with PowerShell and endpoint automation.

**Technical Skills \& Tools**

* Microsoft SCCM / Configuration Manager (MECM)
* Microsoft Intune
* Windows Autopilot and OS Deployment (OSD)
* Application Packaging and Software Deployment
* Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, and Hybrid Join
* Endpoint Security Baselines and Compliance Policies
* Windows Patch Management, WSUS, and Intune Update Rings
* PowerShell and Endpoint Automation
* ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms

Buscamos un **Senior Endpoint Engineer (Intune)** con experiencia en la administración de Windows y macOS, capaz de liderar soluciones innovadoras, resolver desafíos técnicos complejos y contribuir a la evolución de nuestro entorno de trabajo digital.

SOLICITAMOS

**Senior Endpoint Engineer (Intune) \| Windows, macOS, Security, PowerShell \& AI**

Responsabilidades Clave

1. Proporcionar soporte técnico de tercer nivel para los dispositivos administrados de la organización, incluidos Windows, macOS, iOS, Android y iPadOS, utilizando Intune e Iru, y resolver incidentes escalados para minimizar las interrupciones del negocio.

6. Supervisar problemas recurrentes y comentarios de los usuarios, identificando tendencias que puedan indicar problemas más amplios relacionados con sistemas o procesos.
7. Colaborar directamente con otros equipos de TI, como Seguridad de Datos, DEX, Gestión de Riesgos, entre otros, para garantizar que existan políticas y procedimientos adecuados para proteger a Kelly.
8. Actuar como Experto en la Materia (SME) para líderes de negocio y equipos de proyecto, ayudándoles a crear soluciones que atiendan sus necesidades o problemas específicos.
9. Monitorear lanzamientos de actualizaciones, anuncios de nuevas funcionalidades, incorporación de capacidades y elementos del roadmap para identificar cambios que puedan impactar a Kelly.
10. Diseñar y administrar la arquitectura de Intune e Iru, las configuraciones de dispositivos y los despliegues de aplicaciones.
11. Desarrollar e implementar soluciones únicas para los problemas y escenarios identificados por el negocio.
12. Impulsar la adopción por parte de los usuarios mediante capacitación, documentación e iniciativas de habilitación para la colaboración.

Requisitos Clave (Escolaridad, Experiencia y Habilidades)

1. Más de 3 años de experiencia administrando dispositivos Windows y macOS en entornos empresariales.
2. Experiencia gestionando dispositivos a gran escala en empresas con usuarios distribuidos globalmente mediante soluciones MDM como Intune o Iru.
3. Amplia experiencia en análisis de causa raíz, documentación, resolución de problemas y habilidades analíticas para resolver incidentes técnicos de forma metódica.
4. Experiencia utilizando PowerShell, VBScript y/o scripts por lotes para automatizar acciones o tareas en dispositivos.
5. Experiencia en empaquetado y despliegue de aplicaciones utilizando PowerShell, PSADT, Patch My PC o scripts por lotes.
6. Experiencia con herramientas de soporte remoto y plataformas de gestión de servicios de TI (ITSM) o sistemas de tickets.
7. Experiencia con herramientas EDR como CrowdStrike y Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
8. Experiencia con herramientas de Acceso de Confianza Cero (ZTA) como Zscaler.
9. Conocimientos prácticos de protocolos y fundamentos de redes.
10. Comprensión de los principios fundamentales de ciberseguridad aplicados al soporte de software.
11. Experiencia o conocimientos sobre conceptos básicos de gestión de actualizaciones mediante anillos (rings) y procedimientos de prueba de parches.
12. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, con capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos a usuarios no técnicos.
13. Capacidad para gestionar el tiempo y múltiples solicitudes de soporte en entornos dinámicos y de ritmo acelerado.
14. Enfoque colaborativo para trabajar con otros miembros de TI y socios de diferentes áreas.
15. Experiencia utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para mejorar el trabajo (Copilot, Claude) e integrarlas con otros sistemas (MCP, API).

¿Cómo se Ve el Éxito en Este Puesto?

1. Los incidentes escalados se resuelven correctamente y con un mínimo de reaperturas de tickets.
2. Los usuarios finales se sienten informados y respaldados durante todo el proceso de resolución, no únicamente reciben una solución.
3. Los artículos de la base de conocimiento y las notas de resolución de problemas son lo suficientemente claros para que otros compañeros puedan resolver incidentes similares de manera independiente.
4. Los problemas recurrentes se identifican tempranamente, se determinan y documentan sus causas raíz y se planifican soluciones.
5. Identificar de forma proactiva los cambios necesarios y planificar su implementación.

Una Semana Típica

1. Gestionar una cola de tickets escalados, priorizando según el impacto y la urgencia para el negocio.
2. Trabajar con el personal de proyectos para identificar y priorizar las tareas asignadas al equipo y asegurar el éxito de los proyectos.
3. Documentar problemas nuevos o inusuales para que el equipo pueda reconocerlos y resolverlos más rápidamente en el futuro.
4. Coordinarse con el equipo de TI en general respecto a actualizaciones de software o cambios de configuración que afecten a múltiples usuarios.
5. Brindar orientación informal a compañeros de equipo más nuevos que estén gestionando incidentes de soporte.
6. Realizar pruebas beta de nuevas actualizaciones antes de su liberación general en Windows, macOS, aplicaciones de Office, Microsoft Edge y controladores de dispositivos.
7. Colaborar con el equipo para identificar políticas y configuraciones que deban agregarse, modificarse o eliminarse, así como definir su alcance.
8. Monitorear Wiz para detectar nuevas vulnerabilidades que deban atenderse.
9. Atender consultas del equipo de soporte de Nivel 2 (L2) para ayudarles a fortalecer sus conocimientos y habilidades técnicas.

Compensación y prestaciones

• Salario bruto mensual competitivo de acuerdo con experiencia.

• Prestaciones de ley.

• IMSS.

• Vacaciones conforme a la legislación vigente.

• Prima vacacional del 25%.

• Aguinaldo de 15 días.

• Seguro de vida.

**Importante:** Favor de indicar tu pretensión económica en salario bruto mensual al postularte.

Horario

• Lunes a viernes de 08:00 a 17:30 horas.

• El horario puede ajustarse de acuerdo con las necesidades de soporte para usuarios en Estados Unidos.

jobs.title: Analyst (MDM Data Steward)
jobs.summary: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive...
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The **Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE)** was established to drive analytics and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

**Your Opportunity:** As an **Analyst (MDM Data Steward)** , you will join the GATE organization in a pivotal role partnering with the US-based Master Data Management (MDM) team.

Your mission is to drive data stewardship, improve data quality, and support critical business decisions. You will act as a bridge between technical data operations and business strategy, ensuring our data assets are accurate, compliant, and actionable.

**Key Responsibilities** **Master Data Management (MDM) Operations**

* Data Change Requests: Lead the ongoing processing of Data Change Requests (DCRs) related to Health Care Master Data
* Record Maintenance: Perform rigorous matching, merging, and maintenance of Master records (HCPs, HCOs, and Affiliations) to ensure a "single source of truth"

**Data Stewardship \& Quality Assurance**

* Stewardship: Act as the Data Steward for HCP (Health Care Professional), HCO (Health Care Organization) profile data, and Affiliations
* Discrepancy Resolution: Proactively investigate data discrepancies from internal and external sources
* Data Integrity: Ensure all newly onboarded datasets are accurate, complete, and strictly adhere to defined data standards

**Process Optimization \& Governance**

* Governance Methodologies: Develop and document adaptable governance methodologies to enhance efficiency in MDM, data integration, taxonomy, and reporting
* Automation: Identify opportunities to automate or improve data management workflows
* Workflow Enhancement: Build data products to enhance workflow optimization

**Strategic Analysis**

* Analytical Support: Provide analytical support to develop insights and strategies that optimize data-related processes
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with stakeholders across business functions to translate data into informed decision-making

**Who You Are:** **Education \& Experience**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
* Experience: Hands-on experience in Data Stewardship or Data Analytics operations
* Industry Focus: Prior experience in the Pharma, Life Sciences, or Biotech industry is strongly preferred

**Technical Skills**

* Core Data Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel and SQL is required
* Scripting: Practical knowledge of programming languages such as Python or PySpark
* Domain Tools: Experience with MDM solutions (e.g., Reltio, Informatica MDM) and Pharma CRM solutions (e.g., Salesforce, OCE, Veeva CRM)
* Cloud Platforms: Working experience in AWS services (S3, Athena, Glue, Sagemaker Studio, EC2, API Gateway, Bedrock) Or other cloud platforms like GCP, Azure is a strong plus

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with an unwavering focus on quality, accuracy, and detail
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders and translate technical data issues for business audiences

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100'000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let's build a healthier future, together.

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are hiring an experienced Google Workspace Administrator/Architect to join our Bangalore IT team in a hybrid capacity. Reporting to the Director of Business Applications Support, this role is responsible for end-to-end administration, design, implementation, and support of our Google Workspace platform, with a focus on enhancing team productivity, collaboration, employee experience, and driving the strategic adoption of AI tools like Google Gemini company-wide.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

- Lead the design, implementation, and long-term strategic vision for enterprise Google Workspace tools (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Calendar, Docs) and integrated generative AI capabilities (Google Gemini).

- Champion and drive the rollout, administration, governance, and organizational adoption of Google Gemini Enterprise capabilities across all Workspace applications.

- Develop automation scripts using Google Apps Script, Google Apps Manager (GAM), and APIs to optimize group management, administrative workflows, and AI-enabled automations.

- Configure SAML-based SSO and SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning for seamless, automated user lifecycle management and role-based access control.

- Implement robust security policies, compliance standards, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), AI governance frameworks, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions to secure corporate data across endpoints.

- Resolve complex technical escalations, partner with Google/third-party vendors, deliver end-user training on Workspace and Gemini productivity enhancements, and analyze performance metrics to continuously improve collaboration.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- Thrives in Ambiguity: You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing dynamic environments and emerging technologies like Generative AI as raw material to build something meaningful.

- Acts Like an Owner: You possess a strong bias for action, operating with integrity and balancing high-level strategy with hands-on execution.

- Laser-Focused Problem-Solver: You love running toward technical challenges, focused on finding innovative solutions and AI-driven efficiencies that deliver maximum organizational impact.

- High-Trust Collaborator: You are ambitious for the team, fostering a culture of trust through ongoing, clear, and respectful feedback.

- Dedicated Learner: You hold a true growth mindset, actively exploring cutting-edge AI capabilities and seeking feedback to continuously refine your skills and support your team.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain.

- 10+ years of experience administering and managing enterprise-grade Google Workspace environments.

- Practical experience configuring, managing, or piloting Google Gemini for Workspace and implementing enterprise AI security and usage policies.

- Deep proficiency with Google Admin Console, Google Vault, Google Apps Script, GAM, and API integrations.

- Practical experience configuring SAML for SSO and SCIM for user lifecycle management.

- Proven track record implementing Mobile Device Management (MDM) policies and device compliance controls.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Google Workspace Administrator Certification.

- Google Cloud Professional Collaboration Engineer certification or specialized credentials in Google Cloud AI / Gemini.

- Demonstrated track record of leading company-wide Gemini/AI onboarding programs, user training, and productivity initiatives.

Cognitive is an IT and software engineering services company dedicated to elevating the quality, speed and delivery of today’s US government healthcare programs. With a wealth of clinical expertise and hands-on experience, our team understands the significant challenges our government clients, and their customers, face every day. This real-world experience equips us to develop IT solutions that seamlessly connect all facets of healthcare delivery. At Cognitive, we’re guiding government agencies to the forefront of technology innovation in healthcare delivery.

Position Overview:

The IT Engineer (Apple Ecosystem) will serve as the administrator for our Apple-centric environment. This role focuses on delivering a seamless, secure, and automated user experience while ensuring that all endpoints meet rigorous federal security standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Primary focus will be to manage Cognitive’s Apple fleet and end user help desk service requests
Manage Backup and Disaster Recovery, DLP, and Anti-virus for endpoints
Lead the configuration and management of MacBook laptops using Jamf Pro, ensuring zero-touch deployment, automated patching, and security baselining
Manage help desk service requests using Jira Service Management, ensuring compliance with policies, procedures, and SLA requirements
Design and maintain MDM policies and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools to protect a remote-first workforce

Strong understanding of EDR solutions and securing macOS within a federal healthcare or civilian agency context

Ability to work in a hybrid environment, coming into an office as needed, up to three times per week

Experience working with VA, DHA, CMS, HHS, or similar federal healthcare agencies
Familiarity with FedRAMP Moderate or High environments

Experience in small business or SDVOSB environments with growth-oriented responsibilities

jobs.title: M365 Engineer - Modern Workplace
jobs.summary: Nelnet is a diversified and innovative company committed to enriching lives through the power of service as a student loan servicer, professional services company, consumer loan originator and servicer, payments processor, renewable energy solutions, and...
jobs.description:
Nelnet is a diversified and innovative company committed to enriching lives through the power of service as a student loan servicer, professional services company, consumer loan originator and servicer, payments processor, renewable energy solutions, and K-12 and higher education expert. For over 40 years, Nelnet has been serving its customers, associates, and communities.

The perks of working at Nelnet go beyond our benefits package. When you join the Nelnet team, you're part of a community invested in the success of each individual. That support comes through in our work, as we are united by our mission of creating opportunities for people where they live, learn, and work.

The M365 Engineer - Modern Workplace implements, administers, and supports business-focused Microsoft 365 services across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, and Copilot. This role partners with business and technical teams to deliver secure, reliable, well-governed collaboration, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled workplace solutions. The engineer serves as an escalation point for complex incidents and service requests, supports platform governance and adoption, and maintains documentation, standards, and automation to improve operational efficiency.

Job Description

This position offers a hybrid work option. Nelnet values flexibility and understands the importance of work-life integration. Our hybrid work environment allows associates within 30 miles of an office to work remotely for part of the week, while also fostering collaboration and team connection through in-office presence.

Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. To be considered, candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship as security clearance is required.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Modern Workplace Platform Administration & Governance: Administer and support SharePoint Online, Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, and Copilot capabilities with an emphasis on governance, lifecycle management, reliability, and service health.

SharePoint Online & Content Collaboration: Support collaboration sites, content management, permissions, site architecture, document management, adoption, and information governance practices across SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 workloads.

Business Enablement & Low-Code Solutions: Partner with business stakeholders to identify automation, workflow, reporting, and digital transformation opportunities using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, and related platform capabilities.

Microsoft Fabric & Analytics Support: Support Fabric and Power BI administration activities that enable data integration, dataflows, reporting, business intelligence, and analytics use cases in alignment with organizational governance standards.

Azure Services Management: Administer Azure services that support Modern Workplace solutions, including subscriptions, resource groups, storage accounts, serverless services, application integrations, automation, and operational governance outside of Entra ID administration.

Copilot Readiness & Adoption: Support Copilot for Microsoft 365 readiness, governance, adoption, communication, end-user enablement, and related operational processes.

Integration & Automation: Automate administrative and operational tasks using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform automation, Azure Automation, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and other scripting or integration technologies as appropriate.

Security, Compliance & Change Management: Partner with security, compliance, infrastructure, networking, and service desk teams to maintain a secure, stable, and compliant environment while supporting change management, release planning, DLP, retention, access controls, and platform governance activities.

Escalation, Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Serve as an escalation point for complex Microsoft 365 incidents and service requests; develop and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, standards, operational procedures, training materials, and adoption resources; and mentor or provide knowledge transfer to support staff as needed.

Continuous Improvement & Microsoft Roadmap: Monitor platform health, licensing, service advisories, Message Center updates, Azure and Microsoft 365 roadmap changes, emerging AI and collaboration capabilities, and recommend improvements that strengthen reliability, security, user experience, and operational efficiency.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Information Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, related field, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.

EXPERIENCE:

3+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment.Experience administering and governing SharePoint Online and related collaboration workloads.Experience with Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, or similar business solution platforms.Experience supporting Microsoft Azure services related to Modern Workplace solutions, including platform governance and application integrations.Experience supporting Copilot for Microsoft 365 readiness, adoption, governance, or enablement activities.Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Power Platform automation, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, or similar scripting and automation technologies.Familiarity with security and compliance concepts such as MFA, Conditional Access, DLP, retention policies, and information governance.Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently on complex incidents, problems, and service requests.

COMPETENCIES - SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES:

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to business and technical audiences.Business acumen and the ability to translate business needs into feasible Microsoft 365, Azure, automation, reporting, and collaboration solutions.Self-directed, highly motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic enterprise environment.Ability to quickly learn new Microsoft technologies, business processes, and platform capabilities.Ability to partner effectively with security, compliance, networking, infrastructure, service desk, business units, and vendor partners.Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, service health management, operational documentation, and continuous improvement practices.Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearance.Knowledge in the area of NIST compliance strongly desired.

jobs.description:
[Harvard Business Publishing](https://www.harvardbusiness.org/about-harvard-business-publishing/) (HBP) – the leading destination for innovative management thinking. We reach lifelong learners to improve the practice of management in a changing world. This mission inspires each of us to unlock the leader in everyone – including you!

**The opportunity:**

The Director, Digital Workplace and End User Management will redesign how HBP employees experience technology—moving from reactive ticket resolution to proactive, self-healing services powered by AI, automation, and platform engineering. You’ll eliminate repetitive work, enable intuitive self-service, and deliver measurable improvements in user experience, operational efficiency, and risk reduction, while building and guiding a small, outcome-driven team.

**What you’ll do**

- Lead the transformation of a traditional Help Desk, Desktop Support, and Systems Administration function into a modern Digital Workplace & End User Services team.

- Design and implement AI-first service desk capabilities, including Copilot integrations, virtual agents, and orchestration workflows.

- Build and scale autonomous endpoint management using Intune, remediation scripts, and telemetry-driven health monitoring.

- Establish platform engineering practices across endpoint, identity, and workplace services to enable reusable, scalable solutions.

- Develop API-driven, event-based automation across identity, device lifecycle, and access management workflows.

- Implement telemetry, observability, and signal-based automation for proactive issue detection, self-healing, and remediation.

- Partner with Security to embed governance, compliance, and risk controls into automated workflows and digital workplace platforms.

- Drive zero-touch provisioning and lifecycle management for devices and user access.

- Lead change management, reskilling, and adoption efforts for impacted IT staff and business stakeholders.

- Build and lead a small, outcome-driven team.

**What you’ll bring**

- 10+ years of IT experience, including 4+ years leading a customer support help desk or end user support function.

- Proven track record leading large-scale IT transformation initiatives, including. implementing AI and automation in IT operations.

- Deep expertise in endpoint management (e.g., Intune, MDM), identity (e.g., Azure AD), and automation.

- Strong hands-on experience with Power Platform and APIs (Graph/REST).

- Strong understanding of ITSM and ITIL processes, including shift-left strategies.

- Experience with telemetry, monitoring, and event-driven architectures.

- Data-driven decision-making style and comfort using metrics (ticket volume, MTTR, endpoint health, UX scores) to guide priorities.

- Extensive change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**You’ll stand out if you have**

- Experience with Copilot Studio, virtual agents, or AI-driven service desk platforms.

- Background in platform engineering or SRE practices applied to end user computing and workplace services.

- Familiarity with tools like Nexthink or similar endpoint analytics and digital experience monitoring platforms.

**What we offer:**

As a mission-driven global company, Harvard Business Publishing is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion, trust, and engagement where everyone is welcome, valued, respected, and feels they belong. In addition to a competitive compensation and benefits package, we offer meaningful programs focused on career development and employee wellness, such as education reimbursement and early-release Summer Fridays!

HBP is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy and pregnancy-related conditions, or any other characteristic protected by law.

$150,000 - $170,000

Above is the annualized pay range for this position. In addition, this position includes the opportunity to earn our annual Performance Based Variable Pay Program. Actual salary will be set based upon a range of factors, including external benchmark market data, individual knowledge, skills, experience, location and internal equity.

Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of passionate doers that work to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and guidance that you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

As a Systems Development Engineer on the Customer Experience Infrastructure team, you will contribute to building innovative self-service infrastructure management solutions that empower operations teams across Amazon's global fulfillment network. You'll help develop AWS-style services and automation tools that enable thousands of solution owners to discover, deploy, and manage their infrastructure needs independently.

Working alongside Senior SDEs and Principal Engineers, you'll implement features across foundational platform services, knowledge management systems, and AI-powered customer experiences. The ideal candidate is eager to learn, comfortable working across the stack, and excited about building tools that make complex infrastructure simple for customers.

Key job responsibilities

Build self-service tools and platform features that enable infrastructure discovery, deployment, and management for operations teams across Amazon's global fulfillment network. Develop APIs, data pipelines, and integrations with AWS services and internal systems to create end-to-end automation that serves both technical and non-technical customer personas. Write well-tested, production-ready code from requirements gathering through implementation, testing, deployment, and operational assistance Work with product managers, UX designers, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver cohesive customer experiences and contribute to technical direction. Enable the reliability and performance of production services, participate in on-call rotations, and contribute to operational runbooks and monitoring improvements.

A day in the life

As a Systems Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on features across the CXI platform — implementing new capabilities, building integrations with infrastructure services, and contributing to AI-powered customer experiences. You'll be partnered with Senior SDEs and Principal Engineers who will guide your growth through code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical mentorship. You'll participate in sprint planning, contribute to design reviews, and gradually take on increasing ownership of features as you ramp. We encourage you to explore innovative AI tools and emerging technologies, bringing your learnings back to accelerate your development and drive innovation in self-service infrastructure solutions. This is a role where you'll grow your technical skills rapidly while contributing to products that directly impact Amazon's operations teams.

jobs.description:
👀 ¿Te consideras una persona dinámica y con ganas de aprender?

🤜🤛 ¿Te gusta colaborar y trabajar en equipo?

💻 ¿Tienes pasión por la tecnología?

Si tienes ganas de poner en práctica tus conocimientos y participar en un proyecto real, no dudes en inscribirte, ¡estamos buscando a una persona como tú!

**🎯 Nuestra propuesta**

Somos la empresa de consultoría y servicios digitales avanzados de la Universidad Politécnica de Catalunya (UPC). Proporcionamos a la UPC servicios TIC con la máxima fiabilidad, rentabilidad y con constante evolución para dar soporte a la estrategia de la Universidad. Combinamos el conocimiento generado en la UPC con el talento y experiencia de nuestro equipo formado por más de 250 profesionales de la ingeniería y la consultoría, adquirida trabajando en proyectos y empresas líderes desde hace más de 20 años. Facilitamos el crecimiento de las personas de nuestro equipo para que sean las y los líderes tecnológicos del futuro. Lo hacemos en un buen ambiente de trabajo y con condiciones flexibles.

Buscamos una persona que participe en tareas de administración de sistemas y infraestructuras IT, atención de peticiones, resolución de incidentes, gestión de cambios, etc.

**🏁 Tu reto**

* Darás soporte al profesorado en el uso de las aulas híbridas de los centros para la docencia (equipos informáticos, cámaras, micrófono y altavoces).
* Dar soporte logístico a las aulas y espacios docentes.
* Resolver las incidencias de los equipos audiovisuales, verificando su correcto funcionamiento.
* Realizar tareas de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de espacios docentes y de salas de reuniones con equipamiento TIC.
* Realizar la operación básica de los sistemas informáticos y de comunicación y sistemas audiovisuales, de acuerdo con los procedimientos establecidos, para facilitar las tareas de los usuarios.
* Realizar las operaciones básicas de los equipos y aplicativos (montaje de equipos, cableado, configuración, puesta en marcha y parada, control de las condiciones...) y el mantenimiento de los mismos (detección y diagnóstico de pequeñas averías, resolución de incidencias, mantenimiento...) de acuerdo con los procedimientos establecidos, para garantizar el correcto funcionamiento.
* Atender a los usuarios en sus consultas y problemas relacionados con los sistemas informáticos y de comunicación, para resolver o encaminar la solución de manera eficiente.
* Recoger sugerencias de los usuarios para mejorar el servicio.
* Controlar el material informático (inventario, préstamos, stock, pedidos...).
* Realizar actividades formativas de ofimática y de soporte a usuarios.

**🔍 Necesitarás**

* ++Formación++:
* Grado medio de SMR (Sistemas Microinformáticos o Redes) o similar.
* ++Conocimientos++:
* Conocimientos de despliegue y configuración de imágenes de equipos informáticos.
* Configuración de equipamiento audiovisual y multimedia: sonido, vídeo, grabación, visualización, videoconferencia, streaming.
* Familiaridad con herramientas de soporte remoto a los usuarios (Teamviewer).
* Nociones básicas sobre seguridad informática (antivirus, malware).
* Nociones de herramientas de administración electrónica (certificados digitales, firma electrónica).
* Instalación, configuración y uso de clientes de correo electrónico, navegadores y antivirus.
* Se valoraran conocimientos de inglés.
* ++Competencias++:
* Capacidad de trabajo en equipo
* Resolución de problemas
* Orientación al cliente y buen trato con usuarios
* Nivel alto de catalán y castellano (hablado, leído y escrito).
* Habilidades de comunicación y de atención y asesoramiento a usuarios.
* Personas dinámicas y proactivas
* **Disponibilidad horaria: jornada intensiva de tardes (13.30h a 21:00h)**
* **Modalidad presencial**

**🌟 Destacarás si**

* Conocimientos de despliegue y configuración de imágenes de equipos informáticos.
* Configuración de equipamiento audiovisual y multimedia: sonido, vídeo, grabación, visualización, videoconferencia, streaming.
* Familiaridad con herramientas de soporte remoto a los usuarios (Teamviewer).
* Nociones básicas sobre seguridad informática (antivirus, malware).
* Nociones de herramientas de administración electrónica (certificados digitales, firma electrónica).
* Instalación, configuración y uso de clientes de correo electrónico, navegadores y antivirus.
* Se valoraran conocimientos de inglés.

🫶**Como UPCnet cuida de ti**

🤝 **Incorporación inmediata**

**🌱 Estabilidad laboral y crecimiento profesional**

⚖️ **Conciliación de la vida personal i profesional**: disponemos de un innovador y premiado programa propio de conciliación "PEOPLE FIRST" porque nos importan las personas de nuestra compañía. Este programa incluye un conjunto de medidas en diferentes ámbitos para favorecer la conciliación:

✈️ 28 días hábiles de vacaciones al año

✍️ Permisos adicionales de maternidad y paternidad, exámenes, etc.

🎉 y otros permisos especiales!

📚 **Desarrollo profesional**: disponemos de un programa de formació continua que te ayudará en tu desarrollo profesional: certificaciones oficiales, campus online propio, formaciones técnicas y en habilidades, formación en inglés, congresos, etc.

✔ Ventajas económicas en el entorno UPC: hasta un 40% de descuento en programas de máster, postgrado y cursos de formación continua en la " UPC School", descuentos en la Optica Universitaria, Deportes UPC, etc.

💰 **Plan de retribució flexible de acuerdo a tus necesidades**: abono de transporte, ticket restaurante, seguro médico y ticket guardería.

¿Te gustaría unirte a nosotros en esta aventura? 🚀

Data Modeler (Erwin / MDM) at BairesDev

* Proficiency in Erwin Data Modeling.
* Familiarity with insurance industry data structures and concepts.
* Background in data visualization.
* Advanced proficiency in English.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, SMB
jobs.summary: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re...
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Solutions Engineer supporting Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB), you’ll be a trusted technical advisor who helps customers understand how 1Password can address their security and access challenges. You’ll partner with Account Executives across fast-paced sales cycles, lead technical discovery and proof-of-value (POV) engagements, and connect customer needs to solutions across identity, applications, endpoints, and secrets automation. Your work will help make it easier for businesses and individuals to stay safer online, supporting 1Password’s vision of a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.

Reporting to the Manager, Sales Engineering - SMB, this role is based remotely in the United States or Canada.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

Required

• Bring at least two years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role, ideally in business-to-business (B2B) software as a service (SaaS) or a similar environment.

• Communicate technical concepts clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Use strong presentation, storytelling, and discovery skills to make complex information relevant and actionable.

• Prioritize effectively, manage competing responsibilities, and maintain quality in a fast-paced, high-volume sales environment.

• Demonstrate curiosity, sound problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote-first team.

Preferred

• Bring experience with security and identity concepts, such as credential management, privileged access, secrets management, Single Sign-On (SSO), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or OAuth/OpenID Connect (OAuth/OIDC).

• Understand developer and DevSecOps workflows, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), containers, cloud infrastructure, service accounts, and application programming interface (API) credentials. Familiarity with platforms such as HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure is helpful.

What you can expect:

• Serve as the primary technical advisor for SMB sales opportunities, partnering with Account Executives to provide practical guidance throughout the sales cycle.

• Lead technical discovery with stakeholders including IT administrators, security leaders, developers, DevOps teams, and Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs).

• Demonstrate and position Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), Software as a Service (SaaS) Manager, and Device Trust as an integrated solution that helps reduce risk across users, applications, and devices.

• Run POV engagements that validate customer success criteria, including use cases involving developer environments, cloud-native workloads, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) workflows.

• Help customers evaluate solutions in competitive situations involving Privileged Access Management (PAM) vendors, secrets management tools, and SaaS security platforms.

• Respond to security questionnaires, compliance requests, Requests for Proposal/Requests for Information (RFPs/RFIs), and other technical documentation needs.

• Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Marketing, Support, and Customer Experience to improve demos, playbooks, enablement resources, and customer-facing education. Some travel may be required for select industry events and team offsites.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $75,000 USD and $105,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $71,000 CAD and $99,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password/automation-notice. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice https://1password.com/files/candidate-privacy-notice.pdf.
