jobs.description:
About Aspira

For more than 40 years, Aspira has been the market-leading provider of software and services that help public agencies protect natural and cultural resources while making them accessible for all. Our platform supports everything from campground reservations to hunting licenses, helping millions of people discover, enjoy, and care for the outdoors.

We share our client partners’ mission: to steward resources for future generations, create opportunities for genuine enjoyment of the outdoors today, and expand access so more people can experience its benefits.

Aspira is transforming its technology and service model to give agencies more capacity and insight—streamlined tools, smarter automation, and better connections with their communities. Our goal is simple: make it easier for our clients to conserve what matters most and for their customers to enjoy it to the fullest.

FYI

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Aspira is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas, now or in the future.

As part of our hiring process, candidates may be required to complete an identity verification check conducted through Checkr, a secure third-party service provider. This step helps confirm the authenticity of applicant identities and supports a fair, secure hiring process for all candidates.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this notice and consent to the potential inclusion of an identity verification step as part of the interview process.

The Ideal Candidate

We're looking for a curious, analytical, and self-driven Platform Solutions Engineer to join our Enterprise Platforms team. This isn't a traditional support role or one focused on mastering a single technology — it's about solving business problems by connecting systems, automating processes, and designing scalable technical solutions across cloud platforms, contact center systems, and enterprise applications.

You may be asked to solve a problem involving AWS, Amazon Connect, ServiceNow, Jira, a third-party SaaS platform, or a system you've never worked with before. You don't need to know every technology on day one. You do need to know how to learn, investigate, connect the dots, and determine the best path from a business requirement to a working technical solution.

The ideal candidate is someone who naturally asks, "How can we make this better?" and can independently figure out how to make it happen.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Integration

Design, build, and maintain integrations between enterprise applications using APIs, webhooks, middleware, and modern integration patterns. Develop and maintain serverless solutions on AWS, including planning and executing runtime upgrade and migration projects for deprecated services. Design and maintain Amazon Connect contact flows and routing logic across multiple markets and queues. Architect notification and messaging workflows to support customer- and agent-facing use cases such as availability alerts and status updates. Participate in the implementation and integration of new / existing enterprise platforms.

Process Improvement & Automation

Analyze existing workflows and identify opportunities for automation and optimization, favoring reusable solutions over one-off fixes. Design and implement ServiceNow automations to enforce clean ticket lifecycle states, ITIL-aligned status transitions, and QA review processes. Design and implement AI-powered workflows and intelligent automation across business platforms, integrating AI services. Document architecture, workflows, and integration designs.

Collaboration

Work closely with Platform Managers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Contact Center Operations, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions. Participate in solution design discussions and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

4+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, automation, systems integration, or a related technical field. Experience designing, building, deploying and integrating cloud-based applications and services using APIs. Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

Required Hardware and Software Competencies

You will primarily work with AWS, Amazon Connect, ServiceNow, Jira, and other enterprise platforms. Deep expertise in every technology is not expected on day one. Curiosity, problem-solving ability, and the ability to learn quickly are essential.

Cloud (AWS)

Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, EventBridge, Athena, SNS, End User Messaging, CloudFront, S3, Lex, etc.

Contact Center

Amazon Connect

Enterprise Platforms

ServiceNow, Jira, Office365, WFM Tools

Integration

REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, Webhooks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar AI integration frameworks

Development

Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Git

AI

AI Agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt engineering, Intelligent workflow automation

jobs.description:
### **Company Overview**

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70+ healthcare organizations. More than 600+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit [https://network.id.me/](https://network.id.me/).

ID.me is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found [here](https://insider.id.me/candidate-ai-use-in-interviewing/).

## IT Engineer, IT Operations

### Role Overview

We are seeking an **IT Engineer** to join our **IT Operations team** — the group that keeps the core systems a ~1,000-person company runs on, reliable, secure, and continuously improving. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who takes ownership end to end: you will build the integrations and automations that connect our IT and business platforms, keep critical services highly available, and be a dependable technical resource the rest of the team can rely on.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy. Much of the work here isn't handed to you fully specified — you will investigate unfamiliar systems, reverse-engineer how things fit together in a fast-moving environment, and decide what's worth doing next. You will ship pragmatically, favoring solid, incremental improvements that land over perfect solutions that don't, and you will keep Security, Compliance, and Data close so everything you build stays governed. Throughout, you will raise issues early, communicate clearly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and help the people around you.

If you like owning hard problems in a complex environment, working independently, and being the calm, capable engineer a team is glad to have, this is a meaningful opportunity to shape how our IT organization operates.

### Role Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain integrations and automations that connect our IT and business systems, eliminating manual, repetitive work.
- Administer, configure, and optimize core IT platforms and business SaaS applications, ensuring consistent performance and reliability.
- Script and deploy solutions organization-wide (Python, Bash, or similar) and automate repeatable operational processes.
- Integrate systems through APIs and webhooks — handling authentication, rate limits, retries, and error cases.
- Handle advanced technical troubleshooting across IT systems, endpoints, identity, and integrations, and support escalations from the IT Support team.
- Implement proactive measures for high availability, monitor system performance, and remediate availability and performance issues before users feel them.
- Contribute to disaster recovery planning and execution, ensuring swift restoration of critical services.
- Proactively identify improvements to systems and processes, then scope and deliver them without waiting to be told.
- Create and maintain clear documentation, configuration standards, and runbooks for both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Partner with engineering, security, and compliance teams to develop responsible, well-governed solutions.
- Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to the overall capability of the IT Operations team.
- Communicate technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly and calmly to teammates and stakeholders.
- Perform other duties as assigned to meet team and organizational needs.

### Required Skills / Abilities

- 3+ years of hands-on experience as an IT / systems engineer (or similar) in an enterprise environment, able to carry technical work independently.
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
- Strong API fluency (REST / JSON, OAuth, webhooks) and the ability to read and write code in Python, Bash, or similar.
- Demonstrated experience integrating and automating across SaaS platforms and business systems.
- Experience with applying AI and LLM-based automation to reduce operational toil.
- A self-starter who works with a high degree of autonomy — identifies what needs doing, gathers context independently, and drives it to completion.
- Comfortable operating amid ambiguity and incomplete documentation, quickly building understanding of unfamiliar and fast-changing systems.
- Solid fundamentals in systems administration, corporate directory / identity, networking, and endpoint management.
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the maturity to keep stakeholders informed and to raise risks constructively.
- A pragmatic, iterative delivery style — ship "good enough, then iterate" rather than stalling on perfection.

### Ideal Qualifications

_The qualifications below are ideal, but not all are required. We encourage candidates to apply if they satisfy some, but not all of these qualifications._

- Experience with MDM solutions (Jamf, Intune) and supporting macOS at scale.
- Familiarity with modern automation and workflow tooling, and version control systems.
- Experience with monitoring, observability, and building resilient, highly available services.
- Relevant industry certifications.

Minnesota - Software Engineer

Hollstadt Overview
Hollstadt Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to placing professionals at engagements where they will excel. When you work with us, you'll work with a refreshingly real company led and staffed by seasoned experts who are also down-to-earth, good people. We're committed to treating you with respect and helping you achieve your career aspirations.

Since 1990, Hollstadt has been a trusted partner to more than 150 domestic and global companies and has successfully completed over 3,000 projects. Our continued growth has created challenging and rewarding opportunities for accomplished IT and Business Consultants. Hollstadt Consulting is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran.

By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Hollstadt Consulting and its affiliates, and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel at any time.

Job Description

Role: End User Compute Engineer

Location: Onsite in Lakeville, MN, with travel to Northfield, MN 1 day every 3 weeks

Duration: 1 year

Rate: $35/hour W2

Position Summary

We are seeking an End User Compute Engineer to provide hands-on technical support and endpoint management for a growing enterprise environment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical issues, delivering exceptional customer experiences, and serving as a trusted technology partner across the organization.

You will support a broad range of end-user technologies, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, collaboration platforms, and conference room technologies. In addition to day-to-day support, you'll play an important role in improving endpoint management, patching strategies, conference room reliability, and overall user productivity.

This opportunity offers a mix of technical troubleshooting, executive support, endpoint administration, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement, making it an excellent fit for someone who enjoys both operational support and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

End User Support & Issue Resolution

Resolve technical issues from a prioritized support queue, ensuring timely and professional service.
Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, networking, and end-user computing issues across Windows, macOS, mobile devices, printers, phones, and peripherals.
Provide support for both onsite and remote employees while maintaining a consistent user experience across locations.
Deliver high-touch support to senior leaders and key stakeholders when required.
Communicate clearly with users, provide status updates, and ensure issues are fully resolved.

Collaboration & Meeting Technology Support

Support, maintain, and troubleshoot conference room technologies, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, video conferencing systems, digital displays, projectors, and related AV equipment.
Ensure meeting rooms are operational, reliable, and ready for business-critical meetings.
Assist with deployment and optimization of collaboration technologies across multiple sites.

Endpoint Administration & Device Management

Configure, deploy, secure, and support endpoint devices in accordance with enterprise standards.
Utilize endpoint management platforms such as Intune, ManageEngine, or similar tools to manage devices and software.
Support endpoint security initiatives, including BitLocker, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on technologies, and compliance requirements.
Develop and enhance endpoint patching and software deployment processes to improve reliability and reduce risk.

IT Operations & Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate with infrastructure, security, application, and productivity teams to resolve complex technical issues.
Support enterprise technology initiatives, including software rollouts, system upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
Manage and prioritize requests through the IT service management platform.
Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.

Continuous Improvement

Identify recurring issues, analyze trends, and recommend long-term solutions.
Conduct proactive system checks and preventative maintenance activities.
Help improve support processes, workflows, and user experiences across the organization.
Provide training, guidance, and knowledge sharing to end users and junior support staff.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in IT support, desktop engineering, endpoint management, or a similar end-user computing role.
Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows environments, Microsoft 365 applications, mobile devices, hardware, peripherals, and collaboration technologies.
Experience supporting enterprise endpoint technologies, including device configuration, deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
Experience administering and supporting:

Windows Enterprise environments
Active Directory
Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Office applications)
Group Policy
BitLocker
Single Sign-On (SSO)
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

Experience with IT ticketing and service management platforms such as ServiceNow or similar tools.
Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues independently.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to lift up to 45 pounds when supporting endpoint and conference room equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms, conference room technologies, and audio-visual systems.
Experience providing executive or white-glove support to senior leadership.
Familiarity with endpoint management tools such as Intune, ManageEngine, or Lansweeper.
Basic PowerShell scripting experience for automation and administration tasks.
ITIL certification or practical knowledge of ITIL service management principles.
Experience supporting hybrid work environments and remote employees.
Familiarity with compliance, security audits, or regulated environments.
Experience independently leading small endpoint management or user technology improvement projects.

Technical Environment

Candidates can expect to work with technologies including:

Windows Enterprise
Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Office Suite)
Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR)
Active Directory
Intune
ManageEngine
Lansweeper
ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
BitLocker
MFA and Single Sign-On technologies
Group Policy
Mobile device management tools
Printers, VoIP phones, and enterprise peripherals
PowerShell
Video conferencing and audio-visual systems

What Success Looks Like

Successful individuals in this role are highly customer-focused and take ownership of issues from initial contact through resolution. They combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with professionalism, empathy, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

You will thrive if you:

Enjoy solving complex technology problems in fast-paced environments.
Build trust through clear communication and follow-through.
Can balance urgent support needs with long-term process improvements.
Work effectively across multiple IT teams and business groups.
Take a proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing issues before they impact users.
Are comfortable supporting everyone from frontline employees to executive leadership.
Continuously seek opportunities to improve technology, processes, and the overall user experience.

Why Join This Opportunity

Play a visible role supporting critical business users and technology solutions.
Work with a broad range of modern endpoint, collaboration, and workplace technologies.
Gain exposure to enterprise-scale IT operations and cross-functional initiatives.
Help shape endpoint management, patching, and support processes that directly impact employee productivity.
Enjoy a varied role that combines hands-on technical support, project work, collaboration technologies, and continuous improvement efforts.
Join a team that values service excellence, operational reliability, and technology innovation.

Travel: Less than 5%

Additional Expectations: Occasional after-hours support and on-call responsibilities as needed.

Benefits + Perks

Comprehensive Benefit Plan

Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between!

Remarketing Process

Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise.

Professional Development

Hollstadt offers on-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI).

401k + Matching

One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor.

Bonus Opportunities

We appreciate and reward loyalty. Join Hollstadt, stay for 5 years, and we’ll give you a $5,000 Longevity Award bonus! Additionally, we know great talent knows other great talent. If you are on contract with Hollstadt and refer one of your connections who gets placed, we’ll pay you $1,000!

Ongoing Support & Networking

We have made a significant investment in building a support program for our consultant team - so you never have to feel like you are going it alone. We also have a Consultant Coach program which acts like a 'work buddy' to provide a safe ear for questions or concerns at your client site.

jobs.summary: Mission Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce...
jobs.description:
Mission

Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce poste de direction stratégique et technique combine des compétences en architecture cloud, en environnement de travail moderne, en sécurité, en gestion des identités, en collaboration et en infrastructure afin de fournir des services numériques sécurisés, évolutifs, résilients et centrés sur l’utilisateur.

L’architecte dirige le comité cloud, qui fait office d’instance d’approbation pour l’adoption et le déploiement de nouveaux services cloud au sein du groupe.

Principales responsabilités

Stratégie et architecture cloud

• Définir et maintenir la stratégie et la feuille de route d’entreprise relatives au cloud Microsoft.

• Concevoir des architectures cloud sécurisées, évolutives, hautement disponibles et rentables.

• S’assurer que les solutions cloud sont en adéquation avec les objectifs métier, les exigences de sécurité et les normes de conformité.

• Mettre en place des « Azure Landing Zones » et des modèles de gouvernance du cloud.

Architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique

• Définir la vision et l’architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique.

• Concevoir des plateformes de collaboration et de productivité à l’aide de Microsoft 365.

• Diriger les initiatives de transformation de l’environnement de travail favorisant le travail hybride et à distance.

• Améliorer la productivité des collaborateurs et leur expérience numérique grâce à des services innovants liés à l’environnement de travail.

Identité, sécurité et conformité

• Concevoir la gestion des identités et des accès de l’entreprise à l’aide de Microsoft Entra ID.

• Définir et mettre en oeuvre une sécurité « Zero Trust » Principes de sécurité.

• Concevoir des solutions d’accès conditionnel, de gouvernance des identités, d’authentification multifactorielle (MFA) et de gestion des accès privilégiés.

• Mettre en place des contrôles de sécurité maîtrisant : la suite Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, la prévention des pertes de données (DLP) et la protection des informations.

Garantir la conformité aux réglementations du secteur et aux politiques d’entreprise.

Gestion des terminaux et des appareils

• Définir une stratégie moderne de gestion des terminaux.

• Diriger l’initiative Microsoft Intune.

• Mettre en oeuvre : Windows Autopilot, la gestion des appareils mobiles (MDM), la gestion des applications mobiles (MAM), la sécurité des terminaux et les politiques de conformité des appareils

Leadership technique

• Agir en tant qu’autorité technique senior pour les technologies cloud et d’environnement de travail.

• Diriger les comités d’examen de l’architecture et les comités de gouvernance technique.

• Définir les normes d’ingénierie et les meilleures pratiques.

• Servir de point de relais pour les problèmes techniques critiques.

Votre profil

Qualifications et compétences

• Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans les infrastructures informatiques, le cloud et les services liés à l’environnement de travail.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans la conception de solutions cloud Azure.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans l’architecture d’environnements Microsoft 365 d’entreprise.

• Expérience avérée dans la direction de programmes de transformation numérique et de migration vers le cloud.

• Expérience dans la gestion de plateformes cloud et d’environnement de travail à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

• Solide expérience en matière de sécurité, de conformité et de gestion des identités.

Compétences techniques requises

• Technologies cloud : Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Networking, AKS, Azure Virtual Desktop, AzureSurveillance, Azure Backup & Recovery, gouvernance Azure, gestion des coûts Azure.

• Microsoft 365 : Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive Entreprise, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform.

• Sécurité et identité : Microsoft Entra ID, accès conditionnel, gestion des identités privilégiées (PIM), Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, architecture Zero Trust

• Gestion des terminaux : Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, gestion des appareils mobiles

• Automatisation et DevOps : PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power Automate, API Microsoft Graph

Certifications souhaitées :

Microsoft Certified : Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Microsoft 365 Certified : Enterprise Administrator Expert

Microsoft Certified : Cybersecurity Architect Expert

Microsoft Certified : Identity and Access Administrator Associate

Microsoft Certified : DevOps Engineer Expert

Microsoft Certified : Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

- Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

- Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

- Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

- Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

- Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

- Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

- Experience with OSquery and Santa

- Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

- Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering — Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They’ll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship — from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of technical work experience in an IT role, with 2+ years in an IT engineering or systems administrator role focused on cloud-first endpoint management

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and CI/CD workflows applied to device management In an enterprise fleet at scale (500+ endpoints), meeting security benchmarks such as third-party patch compliance goals.

- Demonstrated senior level experience with Apple MDM platforms e.g Iru

- Hands-on experience designing and shipping automation with agentic or LLM-based components in an IT or device management context — and the judgment to know when existing tooling is the better answer.

- Professional-level scripting abilities in Bash, as well as other shell scripts for endpoint automation and fleet operations

- Hands-on experience implementing device trust principles including phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, and endpoint compliance policies at scale

Bonus points for:

- Knowledge of IT change management and service management best practices (ITIL, etc.)

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .

The IT Tooling team sits within IT Support & Services (ITSS) and builds the automations that power ITSS's own operations. Our in-house bot, Ask IT, deflects the majority of company-wide IT requests before they reach a human. Beyond that, we automate ITSS's core day-to-day workflows — ticket triage, access reviews, onboarding and offboarding — which employees experience as self-service. You'll own technical domains within the IT Tooling platform and partner with regional IT teams across APAC, EMEA, and AMER through platforms including n8n, Jira, Okta, Airflow, and Temporal.

What You'll Do

- Own the technical architecture of IT Tooling automations, driving design decisions on system structure, integration patterns, and tooling across n8n, Airflow, Temporal, and Jira

- Establish architecture standards and code review practices that raise the team's overall engineering bar

- Lead as technical DRI on the most complex, highest-impact automation projects, from discovery and design through production delivery

- Partner with Security, Corporate Engineering, and IAM to resolve technical blockers and represent the team in cross-functional architecture discussions

- Build shared frameworks and reusable components that reduce single points of failure across the platform

- Produce architecture documentation and decision records that enable the team to scale with minimal dependency on any single individual

- Manage your own workload with a high degree of independence, translating loosely scoped problems into production-ready technical specifications

Required Skills and Experience

- 5+ years of experience in IT engineering, automation, or systems engineering, with demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions, engineering standards, or platform-level systems that others build on top of

- Deep expertise building and maintaining complex automations using n8n, Airflow, Temporal, Jira Automation, or Workato, paired with strong Git-based development workflows including branching, CI/CD, and code review

- Working knowledge of Okta, Slack API, and Google Workspace administration sufficient to design secure, scalable automation architecture

- Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and translate loosely scoped problems into production-ready technical specifications

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.description:
Truveta provides unprecedented real-world data and real-time intelligence, powered by a dataset built with and owned by US health systems united in a mission of Saving Lives with Data. Together, we power breakthrough medical discoveries, accelerate regulatory-grade evidence, and improve patient care. Today, Truveta enables research on more than 130 million de-identified patients across the US.

Achieving Truveta’s ambitious mission requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values .

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking candidates inspired by the opportunity to securely apply data in the development of real-world health solutions. Beyond core capabilities, we seek problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. We do things the right way. Our commitment to security and compliance assurance cannot be stressed enough. This position is critical to ensuring we are successful.

If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.

This Opportunity

The successful candidate will design and support solutions that support the company’s Digital Workplace strategy. They will work on leading edge technologies that help modernize endpoint management by leveraging the cloud to quickly deliver end-user improvements.

Responsibilities:

- Device Management: Define, implement and maintain endpoint hardening baselines for Windows, macOS, and Linux systems with MDM such as Microsoft Intune, and JAMF.

- Policy & Hardening: Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures for all endpoint devices. Implement system hardening configurations based on industry best practices.

- Deploy & Manage Security Tools: Implement, configure, and maintain endpoint security solutions, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Extended Detection and Response (XDR), antivirus/anti-malware software, and host-based firewalls.

- Incident Response: Collaborate with IT and Security team to respond to endpoint-related incidents. Triage, remediate, and contain security incidents and threats on endpoints. Perform forensic analysis when necessary.

- Vulnerability Management: Manage the endpoint vulnerability lifecycle, from discovery and assessment to remediation, using scanning tools and patch management systems.

- Patch Management: Design and oversee the deployment of updates, security patches for operating system and applications.

- Automation & Scripting: Develop scripts and automation (e.g., using Python, PowerShell) to streamline security operations, automate repetitive tasks, and improve response times.

- AI Protection: Secure endpoints used for AI development, including devices accessing model weights, training data, and production inference systems, implementing guardrails on AI tool usage (e.g., prompt injection prevention in local LLM dev tools, restricted plugins/add-ons).

- Data Loss Prevention: Enforce data loss prevention (DLP) and encryption policies on devices used to handle sensitive AI training datasets, including PHI/PII and proprietary corporation data.

- On-call: Ability to participate in On-call rotation.

- On-site: This position requires daily onsite work at Truveta office in Hyderabad.

Qualifications

- Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on experience in an endpoint security, cybersecurity engineering, or similar role.

- Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of modern operating systems (Windows, macOS) and their architecture, configuration and deployment in a large enterprise environment.

- Cloud Experience : Strong hands-on experience on Azure Cloud PC, VM, Azure Firewall and Azure Networking.

- MDM Expertise: Strong hands-on experience on Microsoft Intune and JAMF administration, such as device enrollment, OS upgrade/patch, configuration, profile.

- Policy Management: Define and assign compliance/security policies to ensure corporation devices meet organizational security standards.

- Application Management: Strong hands-on experience on applications control, deployment, patch and upgrade.

- EPM: Proven experience with industry-leading EPM platforms such as CyberArk and BeyondTrust to control user privileged access and provide advanced threat protection and vulnerability management.

- Networking: Solid understanding of TCP/IP IPv4/v6, experience of office network (Routing / Switching / WAN, Wi-Fi & Security) management and network security concepts.

- Security Principles: Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE), threat intelligence, and incident response methodologies.

- Compliance: Experiences with SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST, and ISO compliance frameworks. Interact with the compliance team to ensure the company compliant and remediate gaps during compliance finding and controls.

- Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication/presentation, ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Location: Tampa, FL (1006 Bearss Ave)

We are seeking an experienced Endpoint Engineer to support a large enterprise Windows environment. This role is responsible for engineering, administering, and optimizing endpoint management solutions with a strong focus on Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), PowerShell automation, application packaging, software deployment, and endpoint security.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing enterprise Windows endpoints, automating endpoint administration, maintaining SCCM client health, and partnering with Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams to improve endpoint reliability, compliance, and operational efficiency.

Administer and support Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) in a large enterprise environment.
Package, test, and deploy enterprise applications using SCCM application packages and task sequences.
Create, maintain, and troubleshoot SCCM task sequences for operating system and application deployments.
Monitor SCCM client health and proactively remediate endpoint issues.
Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate software deployment, endpoint administration, and operational processes.
Utilize Remote PowerShell for enterprise-scale endpoint administration and troubleshooting.
Partner with Cybersecurity teams to remediate vulnerabilities identified through Tenable, Microsoft Defender, or similar platforms.

4+ years of experience supporting enterprise Windows endpoint environments.
Strong experience administering Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM).
Experience with enterprise application packaging and software deployment.
Experience creating and supporting SCCM Task Sequences.
Strong PowerShell scripting experience, including Remote PowerShell.
Experience troubleshooting SCCM client issues and performing client health remediation.
Experience supporting Windows 10 and Windows 11.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Experience with vulnerability remediation using Tenable, Microsoft Defender, or similar platforms.
Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Experience with Microsoft Intune.
Experience with Windows Autopilot.

Experience supporting enterprise End User Computing (EUC) environments.

jobs.description:
Build What Matters Most—Families, Futures, and Your Career

Enjoy meaningful work while contributing to an organization that changes lives every day. US Fertility, the nation’s leading partnership of physician-led fertility practices, is redefining what it means to build a career in reproductive medicine.

Our team members choose to build their career home at US Fertility because of the hope we inspire in our patients, the lives we help bring into the world, and the culture of excellence we foster across our organization. We share a deep commitment to continuously improving the patient experience and advancing research and development in one of the most dynamic and impactful fields of medicine.

Through our national network of premier fertility centers we combine clinical expertise, scientific innovation, and compassionate care. The work we do building families offers purpose, challenge, and personal reward—and we’re just getting started.

Opportunity Overview

We have an immediate opening for a Senior Enterprise Systems Administrator to join our team at US Fertility working Hybrid in our Rockville, Maryland office.

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Compensation: $100,000 to $110,000 per year (commensurate with experience)

This role provides the opportunity to grow within a nationally respected organization while remaining closely connected to the patients and teams you support every day.

How You’ll Contribute

At US Fertility, collaboration is fundamental to how we work. There is undeniable strength in numbers—and support is always within reach. Whether collaborating with more than 200 highly respected physicians nationwide or partnering with colleagues who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, you’ll be surrounded by a team committed to shared success.

In this role, the Senior Enterprise Systems Administrator will:

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Perform Endpoint Engineering
Serve as the primary technical owner for MECM/SCCM and Intune across 4,000+ endpoints
Own a small but mighty Jamf management environment for ~100 Mac devices/iPads
Design, build, and maintain Windows imaging processes and task sequences
Implement and optimize Windows Autopilot deployments
Configure and manage kiosk mode devices
Build, test, and deploy enterprise software packages
Drive modernization through stronger Intune adoption and co-management strategy
Developing proactive hardware and software lifecycle management processes

Patching & Compliance

Design and maintain Windows patch management processes using MECM and Intune
Improve compliance reporting and remediation processes
Ensure endpoints meet security and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, SOX, etc.)
Ensure Mac devices are kept up to date through Jamf

Automation & Optimization

Identify manual or inefficient processes and automate them using PowerShell and modern management tools
Improve deployment consistency and reliability
Reduce task sequence failures and patching exceptions

Advanced Troubleshooting

Troubleshoot complex endpoint issues across MECM, Intune, and Group Policy
Perform detailed log analysis (client logs, task sequence logs, Windows event logs, etc.)
Resolve co-management conflicts and deployment failures
Escalation point for advanced endpoint-related technical issues

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

Document build standards, processes, and configurations
Provide guidance to team members on endpoint-related procedures
Train additional team members in standard maintenance and deployment tasks

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for professionals who bring both technical skill and a deep sense of responsibility to the care experience—individuals who thrive in environments where excellence, empathy, and accountability matter.

Qualifications and Skills Include:

5+ years of enterprise endpoint management experience
5+ years building and maintaining Windows imaging task sequences
Strong hands-on expertise in:
Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM)
Microsoft Intune
Co-management configuration and troubleshooting
Windows Autopilot
Active Directory Group Policy (GPO)
Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience
Experience designing and maintaining automated patch management processes
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot using logs and identify root cause
Experience supporting endpoints in a regulated environment
Ability to independently execute technical projects
Ability to lift 30+ lbs
Experience with Jamf
Experience migrating workloads from MECM to Intune
Experience with conditional access and compliance policies
Experience developing reporting and compliance metrics

More important than any single credential, however, is the right person. Team members who are most successful at US Fertility embrace our mission, live our values, and remain committed to continuous improvement—for themselves, their colleagues, and the patients we serve.

What We Offer

US Fertility is proud to provide a competitive, comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team members—professionally and personally—across all employment types.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with company match

Life and disability benefits

Employee wellness and recognition programs

Part-Time Employees

Performance-based bonus opportunities
Employee wellness and recognition programs

Per Diem Employees

401(k) with company match
Employee wellness and recognition programs

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Opportunity

US Fertility and its network partners believe that a diverse workforce is essential to fulfilling our mission of expanding patient access to the highest standards of fertility care. We are committed to equitable and inclusive hiring practices that ensure our clinical and operational teams reflect and support the diverse communities and patients we serve.

Across our national footprint, US Fertility is a leader in offering clinical, administrative, and operational career opportunities at locations throughout the United States. We are equally committed to developing individual strengths, promoting from within, and supporting long-term career growth.

This is a moment of growth, innovation, and impact. Take the next step in your career with US Fertility—and help shape the future of fertility care.

Endpoint Management & Administration

Administer endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune, Windows Update for Business, RMM tools, and endpoint security solutions.

jobs.description:
Description

Leidos is seeking a skilled and driven Endpoint Security as a Service (ESS) Engineer and Systems Administrator to join our team at the Washington Navy Yard — where innovation meets mission.

What You’ll Do

As an ESS Engineer and Systems Administrator, you won’t just maintain systems — you’ll elevate them. You’ll be part of a collaborative team that installs, configures, and fine-tunes advanced security solutions to ensure critical network infrastructure runs at peak performance. You’ll also evaluate emerging technologies and shape the future of endpoint protection across a highly sensitive environment. You will ensure that our systems comply with the latest security patches and configurations.

Your Impact Includes:

Overseeing the full lifecycle of the ESS and its agents — install, manage, maintain, and optimize.

Creating and deploying custom ESS signatures and policies.

Proactively monitoring ESS for intrusions, failures, and performance anomalies.

Ensuring reliable and secure endpoint operations across all clients and servers.

Troubleshooting ESS deployments and policy rollouts across local and remote systems.

Conducting threat analysis and crafting custom security rules tailored to advanced exploits and vulnerabilities.

Providing in-depth reporting on system health, event trends, and module performance.

Supporting major updates and compliance efforts, including STIG-mandated Trellix upgrades.

Helping design and evaluate network components and develop cutting-edge technical solutions.

Basic Qualifications:

Active Top Secret clearance (SCI eligible).

8+ years of IT experience, including 2+ years focused on ESS (or equivalent experience in lieu of degree).

DOD 8570 IAT Level II certification or higher.

Expertise in Windows Server 2016+ and endpoint platforms such as Trellix Agent, ENS FW, PA, DLP, RSD, and ePO.

Strong analytical skills with a knack for troubleshooting under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

TS/SCI clearance and DOD 8570 IAT Level III certification.

Hands-on experience with RedHat Enterprise Linux, VMware, Microsoft Hypervisor, or RedHat VM Manager.

Familiarity with SADR environments and maintaining ePO servers.

Completion of Basic and Advanced ESS DISA training.

jobs.description:
About the role

Eagle Industries is seeking a mid- to senior-level IT Systems Engineer to own the design, maintenance, and reliability of the company's technology infrastructure. Based on-site in Harahan, this hands-on role keeps servers, networks, and cloud systems running smoothly across Eagle's headquarters, remote sites, and distributed workforce. The Systems Engineer works closely with Eagle's IT Project Manager and coordinates with outside technology partners as needed. This is an individual contributor role suited to someone who takes ownership, communicates well with technical vendors and non-technical staff alike, and keeps Eagle's systems secure, stable, and well documented.

Eagle's environment runs on Microsoft 365 and supports a range of cloud-based business applications across finance, sales, operations, and HR, including Epicor Prophet 21 (ERP), Rippling (HRIS), and HubSpot (CRM), along with reporting and analytics tools including Phocas and Comparatio.

jobs.description:
Senior macOS System Engineer

$110000 - $125000 per year | Charlotte, NC | On-site | Permanent

A bit about us:

We are a large, established organization with a diverse portfolio of businesses and a global technology environment. Our enterprise technology teams build and support the secure, reliable, and modern platforms that enable employees to work effectively across locations and business units.

The Endpoint Engineering team is responsible for delivering scalable device-management solutions, strengthening endpoint security, and modernizing the employee technology experience. The team works closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Identity, Networking, and Support teams to ensure endpoint services remain secure, resilient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to serve as a senior technical authority for macOS engineering within a complex, large-scale enterprise environment. You will have the ability to shape endpoint strategy, lead modernization and automation initiatives, and influence how Apple devices are securely managed throughout their lifecycle.

You will join a collaborative technology organization where you can:

Take ownership of enterprise macOS engineering and platform architecture

Lead high-impact automation, security, and modernization initiatives

Work with modern endpoint-management and cloud-identity technologies

Solve complex technical challenges across a large, distributed environment

Partner with experienced professionals across Security, Identity, Infrastructure, and Networking

Mentor other engineers and help establish endpoint-engineering standards and best practices

Job Details

Position Overview

The Senior macOS Systems Engineer is responsible for engineering, maintaining, automating, and securing the organization’s macOS endpoint ecosystem and its supporting infrastructure. This individual will serve as a senior technical resource for macOS device management, endpoint security, automation, and enterprise client-engineering initiatives.

As a member of the Endpoint Engineering team, this role will focus on delivering scalable, secure, and modern management solutions for macOS devices across a global enterprise environment. Responsibilities include endpoint lifecycle management, operating-system deployment, application packaging, software distribution, patch management, security compliance, automation, and platform optimization.

The ideal candidate brings deep macOS platform expertise, strong engineering and scripting capabilities, and the ability to lead complex technical initiatives while maintaining the stability and reliability of critical endpoint services.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering and Platform Management

Serve as the senior macOS subject-matter expert for endpoint-engineering operations, technical initiatives, and escalations.

Engineer, administer, maintain, and optimize enterprise macOS management platforms, including Jamf Pro and Iru.

Design scalable endpoint-provisioning and lifecycle-management workflows integrated with cloud-based identity environments.

Manage macOS operating-system deployment, configuration management, software distribution, and patch-management processes.

Establish and maintain standardized endpoint configurations across the enterprise.

Implement and enforce device-compliance policies and enterprise technology standards.

Evaluate platform capabilities and recommend improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, security, and the employee experience.

Automation and Scripting

Develop and maintain scripts, tooling, and automated workflows that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual administration.

Create and maintain application packages, deployment automations, and self-service software-delivery solutions.

Write advanced Bash and Python scripts supporting device provisioning, compliance, reporting, monitoring, remediation, and lifecycle management.

Identify opportunities to automate repeatable processes and improve the overall maturity of endpoint operations.

Build reliable and reusable solutions that can scale across a large enterprise environment.

Security and Compliance

Partner with Information Security teams to establish and maintain macOS security baselines and endpoint-hardening standards.

Engineer automated patching, vulnerability-management, and remediation processes.

Support endpoint-compliance programs and respond to critical vulnerabilities and security incidents.

Ensure endpoint-management platforms align with enterprise security, auditing, risk, and governance requirements.

Develop monitoring and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into endpoint health, vulnerabilities, and compliance status.

Infrastructure and Operations

Monitor the performance, availability, capacity, and overall health of endpoint-management platforms.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex macOS, endpoint-engineering, and supporting infrastructure issues.

Maintain and optimize platform architecture in alignment with business growth and operational requirements.

Lead or participate in platform upgrades, migrations, testing, validation, and enterprise rollout activities.

Proactively identify technical risks and implement solutions that improve platform stability and resilience.

Collaboration and Technical Leadership

Provide Tier 3 escalation support to Service Desk and technical support teams.

Collaborate with Infrastructure, Identity, Networking, Information Security, and other engineering teams to deliver integrated endpoint solutions.

Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate requirements and implement solutions supporting operational and strategic initiatives.

Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across the Endpoint Engineering team.

Lead technical discussions, communicate recommendations, and help drive decisions related to macOS endpoint strategy.

Documentation and Standards

Create and maintain technical documentation, engineering standards, operational procedures, and platform-architecture materials.

Document configurations, integrations, automation workflows, troubleshooting procedures, and support processes.

Contribute to endpoint-engineering governance, best practices, and operational-maturity initiatives.

Ensure technical documentation remains accurate, accessible, and aligned with the current environment.

Qualifications

Required Experience

Five or more years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise macOS environments.

Five or more years of hands-on experience administering Jamf Pro, Iru/Kandji, or comparable Apple device-management platforms.

Experience managing large-scale endpoint environments supporting at least 1,000 users or devices.

Experience with modern endpoint-management platforms and cloud-based identity solutions.

Demonstrated experience leading complex endpoint-engineering, automation, or infrastructure-modernization initiatives.

Experience providing advanced technical support and resolving escalated enterprise endpoint issues.

Technical Expertise

Advanced knowledge of macOS administration, configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting.

Strong experience with Jamf Pro and Iru/Kandji architecture, administration, integrations, and ongoing maintenance.

Experience with macOS application packaging, software distribution, and deployment methodologies.

Advanced understanding of endpoint patch-management and vulnerability-remediation practices.

Strong scripting and automation experience using Bash and Python.

Working knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, and Apple MDM technologies.

Experience integrating endpoint-management platforms with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID or Okta.

Knowledge of certificate-based authentication, conditional access, and modern identity-management concepts.

Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and the ability to troubleshoot endpoint connectivity issues.

Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing and workflow-management platforms.

Knowledge of endpoint-security best practices and modern cybersecurity principles.

Experience developing endpoint-compliance, monitoring, inventory, and reporting solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Jamf Certified Tech certification or higher, including Jamf 200 or an equivalent current certification.

Apple platform or Apple device-support certifications.

Experience implementing cloud-first endpoint-management strategies.

Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and cross-platform endpoint-management environments.

Experience with automation frameworks, infrastructure-as-code practices, or API-driven integrations.

Experience supporting enterprise platform migrations or modernization programs.

Familiarity with zero-touch provisioning and identity-based device-enrollment workflows.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities

Automation-first engineering mindset

Ability to work independently within a complex enterprise environment

Strong technical communication and documentation skills

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent initiatives

Collaborative approach to cross-functional engineering and operations

Strong commitment to security, platform reliability, and operational excellence

Ability to balance long-term engineering improvements with immediate operational needs

Comfortable providing technical leadership and influencing decisions without direct authority

jobs.description:
The Application Analyst provides system analysis, configuration, maintenance, administration, and day-to-day support of assigned enterprise applications to ensure reliability, security, and high-quality service delivery across the MBTA. This role serves as a subject matter expert for functional and technical components of assigned platforms, troubleshooting issues, resolving incidents, and coordinating escalations with vendors and partner technology teams.

The Application Analyst monitors system performance, maintains documentation, supports upgrades, and ensures data integrity in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements. This position also supports audits and compliance activities, and serves as a key liaison between IT, end-users, and business stakeholders, delivering responsive and professional service.

Digital Workplace

This role will focus on specialized Enterprise Application platforms that support the core workflows of our organization’s departments, such as Comply365, Microsoft Power Platform for workflow automation, HR, Learning, and Document Management systems, as well as related data integration between these and other enterprise systems.

This is a term-limited and project-specific contractor position that is not employed directly by the MBTA. This hybrid position requires being in the office at least two (2) days per week.Provide day-to-day application support for assigned platforms.

Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, including user access, synchronization, and performance problems.

Serve as a primary point of contact for application-related incidents, service requests, and user inquiries.

Serve as subject matter expert (SME) for all functional and technical aspects of the applications and associated technical components.

Partner with other team members on any application functional or technical issues or questions.

Provide third level support for application issues, including issues with application functionality, environment configuration, and / or system integrations.

Coordinate with relevant software vendor(s) to escalate and resolve complex issues.

Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.

Monitor system health and logs to ensure availability and reliability.

Assist with application upgrades, patches, testing, and release validation.

Collaborate with partner technology teams to ensure proper integration with other enterprise systems.

Develop and maintain application documentation, support procedures, and knowledge base articles.

Monitor and validate user access provisioning / deprovisioning, roles, permissions, and access controls.

Ensure data integrity and security within the platform, following organizational and regulatory standards.

Support audits and compliance activities related to application controls and regulatory requirements.

Participate in disaster recovery planning.

Handle sensitive and confidential information in an appropriate manner.

Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor, or co-worker, in a courteous and professional manner

Participate in the on-call support rotation, responding to emergencies on a twenty-four (24) hour, seven (7) day per week basis while on-call.

Work any and all shifts and / or locations as assigned or directed, including occasional night and / or weekend work. · Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.

Additional responsibilities may include focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Available to work any and all shifts and/or locations as assigned or directed.

Available to work as per assignment by the MBTA twenty-four (24) hours per day, seven (7) days per week as directed by supervisory staff for severe weather conditions, emergencies or any other circumstances that may potentially impact service or the safety of service.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No direct reports.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited instituition.

Three (3) years of experience in system analysis, including enterprise application design, configuration / development, implementation, and support.

Proven ability to map and document complex business processes and identify opportunities for optimization or automation within assigned applications.

Experience identifying and documenting business rules and technical requirements.

Foundational knowledge of cloud-based application delivery models such as Software as a Service (SaaS) and / or technology infrastructure concepts.

Experience with IT service management / ticketing systems.

Strong interpersonal skills to interact with stakeholders, vendors, team members, and end-users.

Ability to work with many different types of professionals in a fast-paced environment.

Ability to work effectively with a diverse workforce and end-user community.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams).

Effective organizational, analytical, multi-tasking, time management, and documentation skills.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts for end-users.

Excellent customer service and conflict resolution skills.

Experience with enterprise applications. Application expertise: Proven experience in the administration, configuration, and support of enterprise-level digital workplace applications (e.g., Comply365, Document Management System, Human Resources (HR), Learning Management System (LMS), Identity Provider (IDP), and Power Platform, etc.).

Power Platform Proficiency: Direct experience developing, governing, or administering solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate and/or Power Apps).

Integration Skills: Foundational knowledge and experience with Application Programming Interface (API) management, system connectors, or data integration tools/middleware.

Microsoft 365 Core Knowledge: Strong conceptual understanding of M365 governance, security, and integration points (SharePoint Online, Teams, etc.).

Experience or interest in the public transit or transportation industry.

An associate’s degree from an accredited institution and an additional three (3) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.

jobs.description:
Overview
A career with Johnson County Government is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to serve a diverse and expanding community in meaningful ways. We challenge ourselves to be a different kind of government because we care deeply about our community and each other. Committed to our shared values, we provide excellent public service, seeking always to improve ourselves and our organization. We offer wonderful benefits, retirement plans, wellness incentives, a great organizational culture, and much more! If you’re searching for something more than just a job, something akin to a calling, then consider the challenge and opportunity of being a member of Johnson County Government!

Job Description
Johnson County's Department of Technology and Innovation (DTI) delivers innovative and reliable technology solutions and services to advance the objectives of County staff, elected officials, and the community in a cost effective and efficient manner. DTI is looking to fill the position of Endpoint Engineer (System Administrator I). This position will be part of the Endpoint Engineering team focused on ensuring all the supported endpoint devices, such as desktops, laptops, thin clients, and tablets, are proactively and strategically managed, and continues to be secure, patched, and supported.

Applications will be accepted through April 22, 2026.

The Endpoint Engineer (System Administrator I) position is responsible for software installations and deployments, patch management on endpoints, and overall client management. Additional duties include the following:

Establishes system specifications by conferring with users; analyzes workflow, access, information, and security requirements. Develops tactical solutions for routine system support, by resolving day-to-day problems for end users of Microsoft Active Directory and other 3rd party applications.
Confers with vendors; develops, tests, evaluates, and installs enhancements and new software. Develops system access; monitors, controls, and evaluates system performance for integrity of data through proper security groups, email distribution lists, external accounts, resource accounts and system permissions; maintains Active Directory user/email accounts through security requests and identifies unused accounts to ensure application of security practices and policies; establishes and tests disaster recovery policies and procedures; completes back-ups, restores information as necessary; maintains documentation.
Maintains system performance of physical and VMWare virtual servers by performing system monitoring, analysis, and performance tuning; installs and upgrades new Windows server hardware and software; applies patches, hot fixes and Service Packs; troubleshoots system hardware, software, networks and systems management; designs and runs system load/stress testing; escalates application problems to vendor.
Develops system access; monitors, controls, and evaluates system performance; establishes and tests disaster recovery policies and procedures; completes back-ups; maintains documentation. Plans, documents and implements projects for new technology and system functionality; coordinates work with other team members for timely completion; analyzes the network server infrastructure for capacity planning.

Job Requirements
Associate’s degree in the following field(s) of study: Information Technology or related field and two (2) years work experience in systems design, programming, systems software and support are required.

Experience with Microsoft Office 365, SCCM, Antivirus Administration, and aBachelor’s degree in the following field(s) of study: Information Technology or related field are preferred.

Experience can substitute for education.

Johnson County Government requires reference/background screening for all positions.

This position is currently eligible to work in a hybrid work environment with both onsite and remote work, after initial training period. Residency within the Kansas City-Overland Park-Kansas City, MO-KS Combined Statistical Area, which generally includes the Kansas counties of Johnson, Wyandotte, Leavenworth, Miami, and Linn, and the Missouri counties of Jackson, Clay, Platte, Cass, and Ray, is required.

Physical, Environmental, and Special Working Conditions:

All County employees may be called upon to assist other departments/agencies in a declared emergency situation.
